Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation
Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child
Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft
Changed the `claude-api` skill to leave Managed Agents sessions in place unless you ask to archive or delete them

title.zh-TW: 背景服務確實終止，關閉程式不再遺留殘存行程
title.en: Background Services Terminate Reliably Without Leaving Orphaned Processes

body.zh-TW: 背景跑著測試或編譯，最怕按退出時終端機卡死或殘留孤兒行程。⟦正如大樓管理員在打烊清場，以前熄燈時只要有庫房機器還在運轉就容易漏鎖後門，現在會嚴格倒數並直接切斷總電源確保全部停機。⟧以前退出程式時如果還有背景指令在跑，工作階段結束掛鉤有時會漏跑；現在結束時若指令在收到停止通知後 1.5 秒內仍未關閉，系統會強制將其終止。停止常駐服務（daemon）時，不會再出現背景服務卡死卻顯示已停止的假象，若無法清除會回報錯誤代碼 1。關閉遙測時停止常駐服務，也不再默默無聲退出卻把工作階段留在清單中。執行背景指令時不再反覆查詢輸出檔或陷入休眠。背景工作階段接續工作流程時，改為透過工作流程工具的核可機制恢復執行。
body.en: Running tests or builds in the background makes you worry about frozen terminals or leftover orphaned processes when exiting. ⟦A building security guard conducts closing rounds: previously, if warehouse machinery was still running when lights went out, the back door was easily left unlocked, but now strict countdowns cut the main power directly to ensure a complete shutdown.⟧ Previously, if background commands were still running when exiting the program, session-end hooks were sometimes skipped. Now, if a command does not close within 1.5 seconds after receiving a stop notification upon exit, the system forcibly terminates it. Stopping a daemon no longer creates the illusion that a frozen background service has stopped, and it returns error code 1 if cleanup fails. Stopping daemons when telemetry is disabled also no longer exits silently while leaving sessions stranded on the list. Executing background commands no longer polls output files repeatedly or falls into sleep. When background sessions resume workflows, they now resume execution through the workflow tool approval mechanism.

items.original:
Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running
Fixed Claude polling a background command's output file or sleeping while it runs
Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` printing "stopped" while a stuck background service kept running: it now waits, force-kills the service, and says so with exit 1 if it is still there
Fixed `claude daemon stop` exiting with no output, and leaving sessions listed as running, when telemetry is turned off
Changed exit to force-kill background commands still running 1.5 seconds after being asked to stop; in fullscreen mode they could previously be left running
Changed background sessions to resume a carried workflow through the Workflow tool's approval instead of running it from the handoff file

title.zh-TW: 工作樹修復分支定位，標籤重名不再開錯版本
title.en: Worktree Fixes Branch Resolution to Prevent Opening Wrong Versions on Tag Collisions

body.zh-TW: 大型專案常需開闢多個工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）處理不同功能，版本切換現在更加準確。⟦好似在資料庫複製多份研究分冊，以前遇到書碼長得很像的目錄卡會拿錯頁數，現在每本分冊都能精準對應到正確的原始章節。⟧以前如果分支或標籤名稱長得像提交代碼，啟動工作樹可能會切到錯誤的版本，狀態中還會出現別的分支名稱；這個辨識問題已經修好。採用新型儲存機制的專案中，分支名稱顯示異常以及無法重新開啟工作樹的錯誤已獲修正。在無法取得遠端預設分支的裸儲存庫工作樹中，會改以當前簽出的版本作為備援基準。啟動工作樹時，外掛對應的建立與移除掛鉤現在會確實執行。
body.en: Large projects often require creating multiple Git worktrees to handle different features, and switching versions is now far more accurate. ⟦Duplicating research booklets in an archive mirrors this challenge: previously, catalog cards with similar call numbers led to grabbing the wrong pages, but now each booklet maps precisely to the correct original chapter.⟧ Previously, if a branch or tag name resembled a commit hash, launching a worktree could check out the wrong version and display another branch name in the status; this identification issue is now resolved. In projects adopting modern storage backends, bugs causing abnormal branch name display and failures when reopening worktrees have been fixed. In worktrees for bare repositories unable to fetch the remote default branch, the system falls back to using the currently checked-out version as the baseline. When launching a worktree, corresponding plugin creation and removal hooks now run reliably.

items.original:
Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`)
Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's
Fixed the branch showing as ".invalid" and `--worktree` failing to reopen a worktree in repositories using git's reftable ref storage
Fixed `--worktree` failing in a worktree of a bare repository when origin's default branch can't be fetched; the fallback base is now the current checkout's HEAD, not the main repository's

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制重連與差異檢視修復，移除無效沙盒參數
title.en: Remote Control Reconnection and Diff Views Fixed with Dead Sandbox Flags Removed

body.zh-TW: 從網頁版或桌面版連回自己電腦操作，遠端控制的連線穩定度與檔案對照都獲得改善。⟦宛如透過遠端監視螢幕查看店鋪，以前遇到短暫訊號干擾就直接切斷畫面，貨架整修時也把撤除的櫃子當成普通移動，現在畫面呈現能如實反映現場。⟧遇到短暫的登入憑證問題時，伺服器不會直接放棄更新連線，而是會自動重試並在需要時提醒你重新登入。當同一台電腦同時提供多個連線時，正在運作的工作階段不會再被誤標為已停止。網頁與桌面端的差異檢視現在能精確分辨被刪除與更名的檔案，不再全部標成修改，並能正確呈現衝突狀態。移除了過去完全不起作用的沙盒命令列參數，若需沙盒防護請在設定檔中將 `sandbox.enabled` 設為 true。
body.en: Connecting back to your computer from the web or desktop apps now offers better connection stability and file comparison for remote control. ⟦Monitoring a storefront through a remote surveillance feed captures this improvement: previously, transient signal interference cut the display completely, and shelf reorganizations treated removed cabinets as regular moves, but now the screen faithfully reflects the floor.⟧ When encountering brief credential issues, the server no longer abandons connection renewals immediately; it retries automatically and prompts you to log in again only when necessary. When a single computer hosts multiple connections simultaneously, active sessions are no longer mistakenly marked as stopped. Diff views across web and desktop clients now accurately distinguish between deleted and renamed files instead of labeling them all as modified, and conflict states display correctly. A previously ineffective sandbox command-line parameter has been removed; if you need sandbox protection, set `sandbox.enabled` to true in your configuration file.

items.original:
Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories
Fixed `claude remote-control` servers giving up on renewing their connection after a brief sign-in error, such as a locked keychain; they now retry, and warn when you need to run `claude /login`
Fixed Remote Control sessions being marked stopped while still running, on a computer serving several sessions at once
Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions
[Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified; requires Claude Code v2.1.296 or later on your machine

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具容錯與自動搜尋修復，斷線重連不再失效
title.en: MCP Tool Fault Tolerance and Auto-Search Fixed to Survive Reconnections

body.zh-TW: 串接外部服務最怕網路短暫重連或格式錯誤，導致整場對話直接拋出中斷。開啟自動工具搜尋時，如果 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器在中途重新連線，這項搜尋功能先前會無故關閉，修復後會持續運作。⟦彷彿接上多功能擴充座工作，以前只要其中一個外接裝置稍微晃動鬆脫重插，整排快捷鍵就會跟著失效，現在即使個別插槽訊號異常也能維持主機正常運作。⟧當外部工具規格被拒絕引發錯誤時，後續對話會改以不帶參數方式傳送該工具，避免每一輪對話都卡死在 400 錯誤。工作階段壓縮後才連線完成的伺服器，其工具與說明會立刻更新。恢復歷史對話時，也不會重複搜尋先前已經載入的延遲載入工具。
body.en: Integrating external services poses risks when brief network reconnections or formatting errors interrupt an entire conversation. When auto tool search is enabled, if an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server reconnects halfway through, search previously shut down without warning; it now remains active after the fix. ⟦Working through a multi-port docking station reflects this resilience: previously, if an external device wobbled and reconnected, the entire row of shortcuts would break, but the host now continues running smoothly even when individual slots experience signal anomalies.⟧ When rejected external tool definitions trigger errors, subsequent turns transmit the tool without parameters, preventing every turn from getting stuck on 400 errors. For servers that finish connecting after session compaction, tools and descriptions update immediately. Resuming conversation history also avoids repeatedly searching for previously loaded deferred tools.

items.original:
Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume
Fixed a conversation failing on every turn with a 400 error when the API rejected an MCP tool's input schema; Claude Code now sends that tool without parameters for the rest of the conversation
Fixed Claude not being told about an MCP server's tools and instructions until its next tool call, when the server finished connecting after a compaction
Fixed Claude searching for deferred tools already loaded earlier in the conversation when a session resumes a history that never listed them

title.zh-TW: 工作階段壓縮與記錄保存修復，斷電重啟對話不遺失
title.en: Session Compaction and Record Retention Fixed to Protect Conversations Across Reboots

body.zh-TW: 深度長對話或無頭程式執行最依賴定時摘要，避免上下文超出容量限制。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）或 Agent SDK 中，若在回答達到字數上限或重試時觸發壓縮，重新連線可能會遺失近期待保留的訊息或摘要；這類情境已徹底修復。⟦猶如厚重的會議逐字稿定期裝訂成簡報，以前只要遇到裝訂途中紙張卡紙，前後幾頁重點就會散落遺失，現在每一份精簡摘要與關鍵頁碼都會妥善釘牢保存。⟧程式異常中斷導致對話紀錄最後一行被截斷時，重新開啟後的第一條新紀錄不再丟失。含有特殊換行符號的對話不再導致分支指令遺失訊息或清理指令略過子專案。縮小自動壓縮視窗時，壓縮指令不會再誤發高額度用量警告。本地工作階段紀錄現在會完整記錄每次請求的系統提示詞與工具參數，方便精準重現。
body.en: Deep, lengthy conversations and headless executions rely on scheduled summaries to prevent context from exceeding capacity limits. In headless mode or within the Agent SDK, if compaction triggered when answers hit length limits or during retries, reconnecting could drop recent pending messages or summaries; these scenarios have been thoroughly fixed. ⟦Binding bulky meeting transcripts into executive summaries follows a similar discipline: previously, a single paper jam during binding scattered key surrounding pages, but every concise summary and critical page reference is now securely stapled in place.⟧ When abnormal terminations truncate the final line of a conversation log, reopening no longer loses the very next log entry. Conversations containing unusual newline characters no longer cause branch commands to lose messages or cleanup commands to skip subprojects. Shrinking the auto-compaction window no longer causes compaction commands to emit false high-quota warnings. Local session logs now record system prompts and tool parameters for every request, allowing precise reproduction.

items.original:
Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window
Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short
Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on)
Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing its compaction summary or bringing back pre-compaction history, when the compaction followed a retried or unfinished reply in the same turn
Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt, tools and parameters, so a transcript you choose to share can reproduce a request exactly

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段修復異常卡頓，容器重置後代理可繼續
title.en: Cloud Sessions Fix Freezes to Let Agents Resume After Container Resets

body.zh-TW: 雲端長任務最怕碰上伺服器重啟或政策讀取失敗，動輒卡住好幾分鐘。以前組織政策若無法讀取，雲端工作階段每輪會卡住 5 分鐘；現在會立刻結束該輪並清楚說明原因。⟦跟租用遠端辦公室的視訊會議系統一樣，以前只要網路短暫切換線路就會讓畫面凍結好幾分鐘甚至重複播放錄音，現在遇到連線阻礙能立刻標明原因並平順交接。⟧當工作階段自身的網路設定阻擋主機時，會誠實回報，不再誤稱是組織政策所封鎖。雲端容器被替換之後，曾恢復過一次的背景代理不會再被誤報為永久遺失，依舊能順利接續。修復了在長回覆期間重啟導致已回答訊息被重複執行第二次的問題。在雲端對話中送出第二則訊息後，斜線選單裡的指令說明不再集體消失。
body.en: Long-running cloud tasks face risks when server reboots or policy fetch failures freeze progress for minutes at a time. Previously, if organization policies could not be retrieved, cloud sessions stalled for 5 minutes per turn; they now terminate the turn immediately and state the reason clearly. ⟦Renting a video conference system for a remote office presents the same reality: previously, a brief line switch froze screens for several minutes or looped audio playback, but connection hurdles are now flagged with immediate reasons and handed off smoothly.⟧ When a session's own network configuration blocks the host, it reports this truthfully instead of misidentifying the cause as organization policy restrictions. After cloud containers are replaced, background agents that resumed once are no longer falsely reported as permanently lost, continuing execution normally. A bug where restarting during long responses caused completed messages to run a second time has also been resolved. Finally, command descriptions in the slash menu no longer vanish after sending a second message in a cloud conversation.

items.original:
Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did
Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once
Fixed cloud sessions hanging 5 minutes per turn when the organization's policy can't be read; the turn now ends promptly and says why
Fixed a cloud session sometimes running an already answered message a second time after the session restarted during a long reply
[Cloud sessions] Fixed most commands in the / menu losing their descriptions in cloud sessions once you sent a second message

title.zh-TW: Cowork 雲端修復檔案寫入假象，改進網頁抓取與權限彈性
title.en: Cowork Cloud Fixes Phantom File Writes, Improves Web Scraping and Permission Flexibility

body.zh-TW: 在 Cowork 雲端環境指派任務，系統以前可能把本機未收到的檔案誤報為存檔成功。以前在雲端執行檔案寫入或編輯時，若指定本機路徑即使檔案根本沒傳到電腦也會顯示成功；這項假回報已修正。⟦類似把公文委託給外勤辦事員處理，以前對方把簽署文件誤存在自己的抽屜卻回報已送達你的辦公桌，現在每份檔案的遞送結果都會確實回報。⟧網頁抓取工具現在遇到剛讀取失敗的網址時，會主動告知失敗原因，不再盲目重新抓取同一網頁。當組織停用永遠允許時，連接器工具的核准提示先前漏掉了允許本次任務選項，這項回退問題已經修好。在雲端掛鉤中核准請求時，掛鉤若嘗試更動模式會被直接略過，但其餘核准項目依然有效。
body.en: When delegating tasks in the Cowork cloud environment, the system previously could misreport unreceived local files as successfully saved. Writing or editing files in the cloud with a specified local path used to show success even if the file never reached the machine; this false confirmation is now fixed. ⟦Entrusting documents to a field clerk once meant signed files could sit tucked inside a personal drawer while being reported as delivered to your desk, but now each file transfer confirms its actual delivery.⟧ The web scraping tool now explicitly explains the failure reason when encountering a freshly failed URL, rather than blindly fetching the same page again. When organizations disable allow-always, connector tool approval prompts previously missed the allow-for-this-task option, a regression that has been resolved. In cloud hooks, when an approval attempt tries to alter the mode, that modification is skipped while keeping the remaining approved items intact.

items.original:
Fixed Write, Edit and NotebookEdit in Cowork cloud sessions reporting success for a path on your own computer, where the file never arrived
Improved WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions to tell Claude that a page failed moments ago instead of fetching it again
Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks in Cowork cloud sessions: a `setMode` update in a hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies
[Cloud sessions] Fixed "Allow for this task" missing from Cowork's approval prompts for connector tools where an organization turns off "Always allow" (regression in 2.1.292)

title.zh-TW: 企業網關加強政策管制，修復代理伺服器與登入憑證殘留
title.en: Enterprise Gateways Tighten Policy Controls, Fixing Proxies and Residual Login Credentials

body.zh-TW: 面對公司安全檢查與網關管制的企業環境，登入憑證與連線政策的控管現在更加嚴密。⟦走進大企業的訪客發卡中心，以前換證被拒絕時訪客身上仍留著舊門禁感應卡，現在驗證未通過就會當場註銷卡片收回權限。⟧以前登入若被強制指定組織的規則拒絕，被拒組織的授權令牌（token，用來證明身分的驗證憑證）仍會殘留；現在拒絕後會徹底清除。在透過作業系統憑證庫進行 TLS 檢驗的代理伺服器後方，新功能旗標與分階段推送能正常更新，不再卡在舊版狀態。託管環境的工作階段現在會忽略設定檔裡的自訂憑證與 TLS 變數，避免覆蓋公司規定。桌面版的 Code 分頁在指定網關時會套用託管設定，啟動時必須確保網關可連線。遇到桌面端無法使用的政策鍵時，網關指令會在啟動時直接指名該鍵並中止執行，不再僅發出警告。
body.en: For enterprise environments navigating corporate security inspections and gateway controls, login credential and connection policy management is now much tighter. ⟦Stepping into a corporate badge office once meant rejected visitors might still walk away holding an old keycard, but now a failed check revokes the card and reclaims access immediately.⟧ When a login was previously rejected by a rule enforcing specific organizations, authorization tokens for the rejected organization used to linger; they are now wiped clean upon rejection. Behind proxy servers that perform TLS inspection through the operating system credential store, feature flags and staged rollouts update normally instead of getting stuck on older versions. Sessions in managed environments now ignore custom certificates and TLS variables in configuration files, preventing corporate policies from being overridden. The desktop Code tab applies managed settings when a gateway is specified, requiring a reachable gateway at launch. When encountering policy keys unsupported on desktop, gateway commands now name the offending key and abort on startup rather than merely issuing a warning.

items.original:
Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login`
Fixed feature flags and staged rollouts staying stale behind a TLS-inspecting proxy whose certificate is trusted only through the OS certificate store
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` sessions to ignore CA-bundle, tool-proxy, git TLS and git config variables like `SSL_CERT_FILE` in settings; under Claude Desktop, only in project settings
Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start
Changed `claude gateway` to stop at start, naming the key, on a `desktop:` policy key that Claude Desktop cannot use from a gateway, where it earlier started with a warning

title.zh-TW: 遙測記錄細分快取壽命，大型請求預設啟用壓縮
title.en: Telemetry Records Break Down Cache Lifespans, Enabling Compression by Default on Large Requests

body.zh-TW: 監控 API 請求花費與除錯追蹤，現在既能看清快取壽命，又能靠壓縮節省頻寬。⟦就像貨運物流單據改版，以前大包裹直接佔滿貨車空間且只蓋一個總重量章，現在先抽真空縮小體積，貨單上還清楚加註常溫與冷凍包裹的個別保存期限。⟧發往 API 的大型請求現在預設啟用 gzip 壓縮以加快傳輸，即使停用遙測也會生效；若想關閉可設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0`。遙測追蹤中加入了快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）壽命細分欄位，明確拆分 5 分鐘與 1 小時的寫入單位。追蹤區間全面補齊生成式 AI 標準屬性，包含供應商名稱、對話編號、工具名稱與錯誤類型。修復了在新型儲存庫安靜提交時，工具執行結果漏記 commit 代碼的問題。
body.en: Monitoring API request costs and debugging traces now provides visibility into cache lifespans while conserving bandwidth through compression. ⟦A revised shipping invoice mirrors how oversized parcels previously hogged truck space with only a total weight stamp, whereas cargo is now vacuum-compressed to save room while manifests note specific shelf lives for room-temperature and frozen goods.⟧ Large requests sent to the API now enable gzip compression by default to accelerate transfers, which remains effective even if telemetry is disabled; setting `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` disables it. Telemetry traces introduce breakdown fields for cache lifespan, explicitly separating 5-minute and 1-hour write units. Trace spans now populate standard generative AI attributes, including provider name, conversation ID, tool name, and error type. A bug was resolved where tool execution results omitted commit hashes during quiet commits in new-style repositories.

items.original:
Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime
Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type`
Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage
Changed large requests to api.anthropic.com to use gzip compression even when telemetry is disabled; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` to turn it off

title.zh-TW: 成果物工具支援單次發布，草稿與文件路徑更完整
title.en: Artifact Tool Supports Single-Turn Publishing, Improving Draft and Document Paths

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 撰寫長篇報告或修改程式碼成品，成果物（Artifact）的產生與微調變得更乾淨迅速。⟦如同在排版印刷工作檯前，以前校對員改一個錯字就得重新跑完一整道送件流程，現在能在同一回修改中立即蓋章出件，桌面邊條上也清楚標明原稿的完整檔案櫃位址。⟧修改成果物時，小幅度更動與重新發布現在能在單次呼叫中合併完成，較大的編輯也能在同一次回答內直接重新發布，不再分段拖延。執行成果物工具時的詳細狀態行，先前在接收輸入時會顯示無法印出路徑的代碼，現在會像終端機指令一樣清楚標示等待中與執行中。工作階段草稿記事中記錄檔案時，會直接採用完整的絕對路徑，不再使用容易造成混淆的單純檔名或相對路徑。當你在對話中提及 PDF 文件時，模型會收到更明確的提示，減少還沒閱讀內容就憑空回答的情況。
body.en: Asking Claude to write long reports or modify code deliverables is now cleaner and faster as Artifact generation and refinement improve. ⟦Standing before a typesetting bench once required proofreaders to restart an entire submission cycle for a single typo, whereas stamping and publishing now happen in the same revision alongside a full filing cabinet path clearly marked on the margin.⟧ When modifying an artifact, minor updates and republishing can now be merged in a single call, while larger edits can also be republished directly within the same response without staged delays. Detailed status lines during artifact tool execution previously displayed unprintable path codes when receiving input, but now clearly indicate waiting and running states just like terminal commands. Files recorded in session scratchpads now use full absolute paths instead of confusing standalone filenames or relative paths. When referencing PDF documents in a conversation, the model receives clearer prompts, reducing instances where it hallucinates answers before reading the content.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does
Fixed Claude naming files in the session scratchpad by a bare filename or relative path instead of their full path
Improved the note Claude 3 models get about an @-mentioned PDF, so they less often answer without reading it
Improved artifact updates: Claude now applies a small change and republishes the artifact in one call, and makes larger edits and republishes within a single response

title.zh-TW: 終端文字對比與選單說明修復，啟動不再重複呼叫
title.en: Terminal Text Contrast and Menu Descriptions Fixed, Eliminating Duplicate Startup Calls

body.zh-TW: 各類終端機與編輯器內建面板的顯示細節，現在能看清暗淡提示且不再重複啟動檢查。在深色 ANSI 主題與 16 色終端機下，次要暗淡文字以前看起來和一般文字完全相同，難以辨識主次；現在已調好對比度。⟦跟換上清晰的儀表板燈光一樣，以前在低對比度的暗色螢幕上看所有讀數全擠成一團，現在次要說明文字有適當灰階層次，啟動車輛時也不再發出兩次引擎自檢聲響。⟧在 VS Code、Cursor 或 Devin Desktop 的內建終端機啟動時，檢查擴充套件的指令以前會重複執行 2 次，現在精簡為只啟動 1 次。沙盒選單中的選項文字由原本容易誤解的名稱改為更直觀的指令名稱。修正了說明文件在介紹限制模式參數時，誤列出已移除工具的問題。
body.en: Display details across various terminals and integrated editor panels now render dim text clearly without duplicate startup checks. Under dark ANSI themes and 16-color terminals, secondary dim text previously appeared identical to standard text, making hierarchy hard to discern; contrast has now been adjusted. ⟦Switching to clearer dashboard lighting reveals how low-contrast dark screens once blurred every gauge together, whereas secondary labels now feature proper grayscale tiers and starting the car no longer triggers two duplicate engine self-checks.⟧ When launching in the integrated terminal of VS Code, Cursor, or Devin Desktop, extension check commands previously ran 2 times, but are now streamlined to launch only 1 time. Option labels in the sandbox menu have been changed from misleading names to more intuitive command names. Documentation introducing restricted mode arguments was corrected after erroneously listing removed tools.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted`
Fixed starting Claude Code in a VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop integrated terminal launching the editor's command-line tool twice to check for the extension; it now launches it once
Fixed secondary (dim) text looking the same as normal text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals
Changed the `/sandbox` mode options to read "Sandbox commands" instead of "Sandbox BashTool"

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器修復輸出凍結，維持健康檢查與輪詢
title.en: Self-Hosted Runners Fix Output Freezes, Preserving Health Checks and Polling

body.zh-TW: 自己架設伺服器跑自動化任務，最怕日誌沒人讀取時整個執行器默默凍結。以前無人讀取輸出時，執行器與調度器會停止輪詢、健康檢查斷線且無法透過訊號關閉。⟦如同自動印表機接紙盤堆滿紙張，以前只要沒人抽走紙張整台機器就會罷工停機，現在會主動碎化舊紙並保留最新頁面繼續列印。⟧現在日誌會保留最新的 256 KiB 並記錄被捨棄的訊息數量，但 Windows 系統除外，讓服務始終保持運作。
body.en: Running automated tasks on self-hosted servers risks silent runner freezes whenever logs go unread. Previously, when output remained unread, runners and dispatchers stopped polling, health checks disconnected, and processes could not be shut down via signals. ⟦Piles of paper on an automated printer tray used to halt the entire machine whenever uncollected, but it now actively shreds older sheets while retaining the freshest pages to keep printing.⟧ Logs now retain the latest 256 KiB and track the count of discarded messages, excluding Windows systems, keeping services continuously operational.

items.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 新增停用自動夾帶選取文字，修復拖曳與選單
title.en: VS Code Adds Option to Disable Auto-Attaching Selected Text, Fixing Drag-and-Drop and Menus

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡提問，現在能防止編輯器選取的文字被自動塞進輸入框。新增 `claudeCode.attachSelection` 設定項，設為 false 即可關閉自動夾帶。⟦好比在便條紙上抄筆記，以前筆尖畫過書頁就會自動抄進去，拖放照片也常貼錯，現在能精準只記下你想交代的事項。⟧在 Windows 下按住 Shift 拖曳檔案至輸入框時，不再插入難以辨認的磁碟機路徑，而是正確產生相對於工作目錄的參照。在 WSL、遠端 SSH 或容器環境中拖曳檔案也不再毫無反應。按向上鍵調出先前的斜線指令再按 Enter，不會再漏掉原本夾帶的參數。編輯曾標記的提示詞時，不會再被突然彈出的檔案選單遮擋。在 Windows 與 Linux 的檔案總管、其他樹狀檢視或偵錯主控台按 Ctrl+Alt+F，現在會開啟搜尋，不會再誤切換成專注檢視（Focus view）。
body.en: Asking questions in VS Code can now prevent editor-selected text from being automatically inserted into the input box. The new `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting disables automatic attachment when set to false. ⟦Jotting reminders on a notepad used to capture every passage your pen grazed across a page while misplacing dropped photos, whereas it now accurately records only the notes you intend to leave.⟧ Holding Shift while dragging files into the input box on Windows no longer inserts unreadable drive paths, correctly generating references relative to the working directory instead. Dragging files across WSL, remote SSH, or container environments is no longer unresponsive. Pressing the up arrow to recall previous slash commands and hitting Enter no longer drops original arguments. Editing previously bookmarked prompts is no longer obstructed by unexpected file menu popups. Pressing Ctrl+Alt+F across File Explorer, other tree views, or the debug console on Windows and Linux now opens search instead of erroneously toggling Focus view.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting to stop text selected in the editor from being added to your messages
[VSCode] Fixed "Edit prompt" on a flagged message opening the file or command menu over the restored prompt; Enter now sends it as written
[VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file onto the prompt on Windows inserting an unreadable `/c:/…` path instead of a mention relative to the working directory
[VSCode] Fixed ↑ then Enter on a recalled slash command running it without its arguments; the command and file menus no longer open over a recalled prompt until you edit it
[VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file from the Explorer or an editor tab onto the prompt inserting nothing in WSL, SSH and Dev Container windows
[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Alt+F toggling Focus view instead of opening Find in the Explorer, other tree views, or the Debug Console on Windows and Linux

title.zh-TW: VS Code 智慧切換思考與額度狀態，修復多重視窗鎖定
title.en: VS Code Intelligently Toggles Thinking and Quota States, Fixing Multi-Window Locks

body.zh-TW: VS Code 裡切換不同模型或重新載入視窗，最怕額度用光後請求一直卡在重送死循環。快速模式在額度耗盡時以前會持續開啟導致請求不斷被拒重送，現在會附帶錯誤提示並自動關閉。⟦就像智慧辦公桌的儀表，以前遇到儲值卡扣款不足還會一直按鈕扣款，重開機後還誤以為上一位訪客沒離開，現在能即時辨認帳戶狀態並精確清空閒置鎖定。⟧對於固定會進行深度思考的模型，介面不再顯示多餘的思考開關。對話字型大小變更現在會立即套用至差異檢視與計畫預覽，不再需要重新載入視窗，也不會被主題切換覆蓋。重新載入分頁或點擊繼續工作階段時，不會再遺失已移至工作樹的分支對話。系統在檢查其他視窗工作階段時改為直接呼叫工具，避免頻繁搜尋路徑產生額外行程。電腦在當機重開後，不會再因為行程識別碼被其他軟體重複使用而誤報對話仍在其他地方開啟。
body.en: Switching models or reloading windows in VS Code risks requests getting trapped in retry loops once quotas run out. Fast mode previously stayed on when quota was exhausted, causing requests to be repeatedly rejected and retried, but now displays an error prompt and turns off automatically. ⟦Gauges on a smart desk once kept pressing deduct buttons despite insufficient prepaid card balances and mistook previous visitors for remaining after reboots, but they now recognize account statuses instantly and clear stale locks cleanly.⟧ For models that always perform deep thinking, the interface no longer displays a redundant thinking toggle. Conversation font size changes now apply immediately to diff views and plan previews without requiring a window reload, and are no longer overridden by theme changes. Reloading tabs or clicking to resume a session no longer loses branch conversations moved to worktrees. The system now calls tools directly when checking sessions in other windows, avoiding redundant processes from frequent path searches. After a crash and reboot, the system no longer falsely reports conversations as open elsewhere when process IDs are reused by other software.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed fast mode staying on after usage credits ran out, which made each request be refused and re-sent; it now turns off until you turn it back on, with an error notice
[VSCode] Fixed the Thinking toggle switching to Off on models that always think; the toggle is no longer shown for those models
[VSCode] Fixed changes to VS Code's chat font size settings needing a window reload or being undone by a theme change; diffs and the plan preview now follow them too
[VSCode] Fixed "Resume session" and tabs restored after a reload opening an empty new conversation instead of one that had moved into a git worktree
[VSCode] Fixed the check for sessions open in other windows or terminals creating extra processes on macOS: it now starts `/bin/ps` directly instead of searching PATH for `ps` on every check
[VSCode] Windows: Fixed a conversation showing "still open somewhere else" after a crash or power loss, when Windows had since restarted and given the old process ID to another program

title.zh-TW: Slack 支援跨組織頻道，新增私人授權卡與語音讀取
title.en: Slack Supports Cross-Organization Channels, Adding Ephemeral Approval Cards and Audio Clip Reading

body.zh-TW: Slack 工作區支援跨企業共享頻道，讓跨公司協作與授權確認不必切換軟體。管理員現在可以允許 Claude 在跨企業共享的 Slack Connect 頻道中回答提問，此功能預設關閉以維護隱私；頻道原有的權限包在升級為跨組織頻道後也會持續生效。⟦走進跨公司的聯合專案討論會，以前只要外勤人員在場助理就會迴避不說話，需要批閱公文時還會當眾大喊拒絕，現在能私下遞上簽核單並自然融入多方對話。⟧當連接器工具需要授權時，討論串中會彈出僅你可見的私人卡片讓你選擇允許一次或拒絕，避免直接報錯，其他人只會看到系統正在等候你的決定。新增語音片段支援，只要 Slack 產生了文字轉錄稿，Claude 就能直接讀取內容。修復了在 Claude 自身發送的訊息下方，若有其他機器人標記它卻未獲回應的問題。
body.en: Slack workspaces support cross-enterprise shared channels, enabling cross-company collaboration and authorization checks without switching tools. Administrators can now allow Claude to respond in shared Slack Connect channels, an option disabled by default for privacy; existing channel permission bundles also remain effective after upgrading to cross-organization channels. ⟦Joining a cross-company joint project meeting used to make an assistant clam up whenever outside contractors were present and loudly shout rejections when reviewing documents, but the assistant now quietly offers sign-off sheets while blending into multilateral discussions.⟧ When a connector tool requires authorization, an ephemeral card visible only to you appears in the thread to allow once or deny instead of throwing an error, while others only see that the system awaits your decision. Audio clip support is added, enabling Claude to read contents whenever Slack generates a transcript. A bug was fixed where other bots tagging Claude under messages sent by Claude itself went unanswered.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added support for Slack Connect channels: an Owner or Claude Tag admin can let Claude in Slack answer in channels shared with another organization; it's off by default
[Claude Tag] Added a private Allow once / Deny card in Slack threads for connector actions that need your approval, so Claude asks instead of refusing; others only see that it's waiting on you
[Claude Tag] Added support for Slack voice clips in Claude in Slack: Claude reads Slack's transcript of a clip when Slack has one
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not answering another app that tags it in a thread under a message Claude itself posted to the channel
[Claude Tag] Changed access bundles an admin attached to a Slack channel to keep applying once the channel becomes a Slack Connect channel, with no need to remove and re-attach them

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查支援隱藏成員觸發，狀態說明直連權限設定
title.en: Code Review Supports Triggers from Private Members, Linking Status Notes to Permission Settings

body.zh-TW: 在 Pull Request 中召喚 Claude 審查程式碼，非公開成員現在也能正常觸發審查流程。以前具有寫入權限的開發者如果將自己的 GitHub 組織成員身分設為非公開，在留言中輸入 `@claude review` 常會被忽視；現在系統能正確識別權限並啟動審查。⟦就像進入管制嚴格的研發中心，以前只要名牌沒公開掛在胸前警衛就不受理申請，現在只要確認有通行卡就能啟動查核，通道封閉時也會直接告知該找哪位主管開門。⟧當儲存庫的審查功能處於暫停狀態時，留言不再引導管理員點進無關的設定首頁，而是會清楚指名有權限修復的人員，並直接附上 Git 提供者設定頁面的連結。
body.en: Summoning Claude to review code in pull requests now lets private members trigger the review workflow smoothly. Developers with write access whose GitHub organization membership was kept private previously found `@claude review` comments frequently ignored; the system now recognizes permissions accurately and launches reviews. ⟦Entering a high-security research facility once meant guards rejected requests unless badges hung visibly on chests, but verifying an access badge now initiates clearance and closed checkpoints directly name which supervisor can open the door.⟧ When repository review functionality is paused, comments no longer direct administrators to irrelevant settings landing pages, clearly naming authorized personnel instead and linking directly to the Git provider settings page.

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review ignoring `@claude review` comments from people with write access whose GitHub organization membership is private; their comments now start a review
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review's "paused for this repository" comment sending admins to Code Review settings; it now says who can fix it and links the Git providers page

entries: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents
Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later
Added `$.prompt.media` so a `prompt.submit` hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt
Added `$.session.identity()` for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed `forceLoginOrgUUID` lists that organization
Added `size`, `weight`, `mono` and `tabular` to a mod's `Text` and named spacing steps (`xs` to `xl`) to its `Box`; `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight`
Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish
Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives
Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; a bare `/model`, `/effort` or `/fast` there now opens a picker
Added a "safe mode" line to the agents view peek panel for background sessions started with `--safe-mode`
Added a one-time note when plan mode won't ask before most edits or commands because bypass permissions is available
Added `--disallow-tools` and a `disallowed_tools` case field to `claude plugin eval` to keep specific built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs
Added support for turning off the attribution block in Claude Desktop's Code tab: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in the `env` of a Claude apps gateway's `code` policy
Added a field to the attribution block in Claude Code sessions behind a Claude apps gateway; remove the block with `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0`
Added a `queue` door to the `session.append` mod hook, so a mod can make the transcript's queue records differ from the prompt as sent
Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin validate` naming a mod's hooks that are skipped where an organization manages Claude Code
Added `/usage` warnings for max effort, workflows, always-on context and large tool results
Fixed the error for a denied cloud session, which could point to the wrong organization when a key from `apiKeyHelper` was in use
Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request
Fixed a mod that submits a prompt at the end of every turn keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, an interrupt, or the end of the host's conversation
Fixed cloud sessions sometimes showing the model's follow-up text after a tool group's one-line label
Fixed the Write and Edit tools creating a mod in a session's mods folder without asking in accept-edits mode when the config directory's path has no `.claude` in it
Fixed installed mods that kept running in an open session after being turned off remotely; they now unload between turns
Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions failing on a message stopped while its `UserPromptSubmit` or mod `prompt.submit` hooks were still running (regression in 2.1.296)
Fixed an agent teammate started without a description keeping part of a credential from its prompt in the task description shown for it
Fixed the claude.ai view of a Remote Control or cloud session freezing when a large batch of events could not finish uploading over a slow connection
Fixed a sandboxed shell command being able to write into a `--plugin-dir` folder, whose code Claude Code reloads and runs outside the sandbox

title.zh-TW: 終端機閒置自動壓縮，長對話不再耗盡提示快取
title.en: Automatic Idle Compaction in Terminal Preserves Prompt Cache for Long Conversations

body.zh-TW: 當你跟 Claude 進行長對話並暫離時，終端機現在會在背景幫你顧好快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）。若對話超過 20 萬個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）且閒置約 54 分鐘，它會在滿一小時的提示快取過期前自動壓縮對話歷史，避免下一則訊息重新耗費完整處理成本。這項功能需要 v2.1.290 或更新版本。你可以設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` 調整觸發門檻，若想停用，可在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 加入 `{"idleCompaction": false}`。⟦彷彿圖書館的閱覽桌，以前讀者離開太久書籍會整批被館員推回倉庫重排，現在專屬助理會在逾期前把重點摘記好，讓你回來時翻開摘要就能立刻動工。⟧
body.en: When you have a long conversation with Claude and step away, the terminal now manages your cache in the background. If a conversation exceeds 200,000 tokens and remains idle for around 54 minutes, it automatically compacts the conversation history before the one-hour prompt cache expires, preventing the next message from incurring the full processing cost again. This feature requires v2.1.290 or later. You can set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to adjust the trigger threshold, or disable it by adding `{"idleCompaction": false}` to `~/.claude/settings.json`. ⟦Picture a library reading desk: previously, if a reader stepped away for too long, staff would return all the books to the stacks to be reshelved, but now a dedicated assistant writes down key notes before the time limit, letting you resume work with the summary the moment you return.⟧

items.original:
Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later

title.zh-TW: 檔案提及支援僅給路徑，文件讀取更省空間
title.en: File Mentions Support Path-Only Mode to Save Space During Document Reads

body.zh-TW: 你在對話裡用 `@` 標註檔案時，現在能讓 Claude 只接收檔案路徑而非把整份文件內容直接塞進提示詞。只要設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS`，Claude 就會改用自身的檔案工具讀取目標路徑。當你在訊息裡提及 PDF 檔案時，系統不再把整份文件的原始位元組留在工作階段紀錄中，減少記憶體與磁碟空間消耗。另外，在 Linux 遠端工作階段中以非最高權限執行時，Read 工具讀取 PDF 指定頁面範圍失敗的問題也已修好。⟦宛如跟研究助理交代待讀清單，以前每次開口都把厚重的整疊原稿直接塞進對方公事包，現在只給圖書館索書號，等他需要時再自己去書架翻閱指定章節。⟧
body.en: When mentioning files with `@` in a conversation, you can now have Claude receive only the file path instead of stuffing the full document content into the prompt. Simply set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS`, and Claude will instead use its own file tools to read the target path. When you mention a PDF file in a message, the system no longer retains the raw bytes of the entire document in the session history, cutting down on memory and disk consumption. In addition, an issue where the Read tool failed to read specific page ranges of PDFs when running without root privileges in Linux remote sessions has been fixed. ⟦Think of handing a reading list to a research assistant: previously, you would stuff a thick stack of original manuscripts into their briefcase every time you spoke, but now you only provide library call numbers so they can pull the specified chapters from the shelf when needed.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents
Fixed Read failing on PDF page ranges in remote sessions on Linux that run without elevated privileges
Improved memory and disk use when PDFs are @-mentioned: their bytes are no longer kept in the session transcript

title.zh-TW: 代理檢視新增參數選單，安全模式狀態更透明
title.en: Agent View Adds Parameter Menus with Transparent Safe Mode Status

body.zh-TW: 管理背景執行的代理工作階段時，現在能在代理檢視裡直接用 `/effort` 與 `/fast` 決定新工作階段預設使用的思考深度與速度。直接單獨輸入 `/model`、`/effort` 或 `/fast` 也會跳出選單供你直接挑選。針對帶有 `--safe-mode` 啟動的背景工作階段，代理檢視的預覽面板現在會多出一行提示清楚顯示處於安全模式，且在工作階段被喚醒或重啟時，也不會再發生無預警脫離安全模式的情況。此外，極簡模式（bare mode）的背景提示不再誤導你重開時省略 `--bare`，而是改為指引你使用 `/stop` 與 `claude --resume` 來退出模式。以前背景工具重開可能遺失防護設定，現在狀態始終維持原貌。
body.en: When managing background agent sessions, you can now use `/effort` and `/fast` directly in the agent view to set the default thinking depth and speed for new sessions. Entering `/model`, `/effort`, or `/fast` on its own also opens a menu for direct selection. For background sessions launched with `--safe-mode`, the preview panel in the agent view now displays an extra line clearly indicating that safe mode is active, and sessions will no longer silently drop out of safe mode when resumed or restarted. In addition, background prompts in bare mode no longer mislead you into omitting `--bare` when reopening, guiding you instead to use `/stop` and `claude --resume` to exit the mode. Previously, reopening background tools risked losing protection settings, but now state remains intact throughout.

items.original:
Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; a bare `/model`, `/effort` or `/fast` there now opens a picker
Added a "safe mode" line to the agents view peek panel for background sessions started with `--safe-mode`
Fixed bare mode notices in background sessions telling you to restart without `--bare`, which keeps the mode; they now name `/stop` and `claude --resume`, as safe mode ones do
Fixed background sessions started with `--safe-mode` silently leaving safe mode when the session was woken or restarted

title.zh-TW: 用量監控新增高消耗警示，百分比數值校準完畢
title.en: Usage Monitoring Adds High-Consumption Alerts and Calibrates Percentage Metrics

body.zh-TW: 查詢用量時，現在 `/usage` 能提前在幾種特別吃額度的情況下發出提醒。當你開啟最高思考深度、執行自動化工作流程、啟用常駐上下文，或是工具回傳大量資料時，畫面都會亮出提醒避免額度驟減。同時，先前在終端機與 VS Code 裡的 `/usage`、額度即將用盡警示，以及顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列（status line）中，偶爾會出現已用額度超過百分之一百的荒謬數字，這個計算異常已經修正。⟦如同汽車儀表板的油耗提示，在車主重踩油門或開啟四輪傳動時主動閃爍耗油警報，並且指針刻度準確固定在滿格範圍內，不再出現指針衝破極限刻度的怪異現象。⟧
body.en: When checking resource usage, `/usage` now warns you in advance during several scenarios that consume significant quota. Alerts appear on screen when you configure maximum thinking depth, run automated workflows, enable persistent context, or receive heavy tool output, helping prevent rapid quota exhaustion. At the same time, a calculation bug that occasionally produced absurd figures exceeding 100 percent in `/usage`, quota exhaustion warnings, and the status line at the bottom of the terminal across both the terminal and VS Code has now been corrected. ⟦Like a car dashboard fuel gauge that flashes consumption warnings when the driver steps hard on the accelerator or engages all-wheel drive, the needle now stays accurately pinned within full scale rather than shooting past the gauge limits.⟧

items.original:
Added `/usage` warnings for max effort, workflows, always-on context and large tool results
Fixed `/usage`, the approaching-limit warning (terminal and VS Code) and the status line sometimes showing more than 100% used (anthropics/claude-code#92238)

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器支援緩衝關機，修復連線與憑證回報
title.en: Self-Hosted Runners Gain Graceful Shutdown with Connectivity and Credential Fixes

body.zh-TW: 維運自架執行器（self-hosted runner）時，調度程式現在能透過 `--shutdown-drain-sec` 參數設定收到 SIGTERM 結束訊號後的緩衝秒數。執行器會立刻停止輪詢新任務，並保留這段秒數讓進行中的輪詢與掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）順利跑完。同時，在執行期間如果連線器設定異動，透過外部包裝檔帶入的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器不再被意外關閉。在主機缺少 Git 登入資訊時，`setup` 與 `doctor` 會給出更清楚的指引。工作階段若在首輪前就輸出內容，先前會漏設釋放計時器而忽略 `--retire-at` 導致延遲關機，現在計時器能正常運作。此外，雲端與自架環境中的 MCP 請求不再跟隨代理伺服器的 HTTP 轉址。
body.en: When operating self-hosted runners, the scheduler can now use the `--shutdown-drain-sec` flag to specify a grace period in seconds after receiving a SIGTERM signal. The runner immediately halts polling for new tasks and preserves this duration to allow active polls and hooks to complete cleanly. Meanwhile, MCP servers loaded via external wrapper files are no longer unexpectedly terminated if connector configurations change during execution. When a host lacks Git credentials, `setup` and `doctor` now provide clearer instructions. Sessions that emit output before their first turn previously missed setting a retirement timer and ignored `--retire-at`, causing delayed shutdowns; this timer now operates properly. Additionally, MCP requests in both cloud and self-hosted environments no longer follow proxy HTTP redirects.

items.original:
Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions shutting down MCP servers added through an `--exec-path` wrapper's own `--mcp-config` when connectors change mid-session
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` sessions using Anthropic-managed git showing tracked files as staged deletions when starting in a reused clone whose remote is still empty
Self-hosted runner: Improved what `setup` and `doctor` say when the runner's machine has no git credentials
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions that wrote output before their first turn being left with no release timer, ignoring `--retire-at` and delaying shutdown
Changed MCP requests in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions to no longer follow HTTP redirects from the session's MCP proxy

title.zh-TW: 應用閘道支援自訂標註，嚴格阻絕黑名單模型
title.en: Application Gateways Support Custom Attribution and Strictly Block Blacklisted Models

body.zh-TW: 透過企業應用閘道串接 Claude Desktop 或終端機工作階段時，現在能更自由地管控簽章標註。如果不想在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 分頁或閘道工作階段中看見歸屬區塊，只要在閘道策略的環境變數設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` 即可完全關閉。歸屬區塊本身也新增了自訂欄位。在安全管理方面，閘道先前在套用精確比對或是黑名單策略時，可能誤將被封鎖的模型對外開放。現在閘道會確實把這些違規模型從清單中排除，若收到請求則直接回傳 400 錯誤拒絕連線。以前權限控管容易出現漏網之魚，現在名單檢驗滴水不漏。
body.en: When routing Claude Desktop or terminal sessions through enterprise application gateways, you can now manage attribution signatures with greater flexibility. If you prefer not to display the attribution block in gateway sessions or the Code tab of Claude Desktop, setting the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in your gateway policy disables it entirely. The attribution block itself also gains custom fields. For security management, gateways previously could inadvertently expose blocked models when applying exact-match or blacklist policies. The gateway now strictly excludes these prohibited models from its catalog and rejects matching requests by returning a 400 error. Permission enforcement previously risked leaking blocked entries, but list verification is now airtight.

items.original:
Added support for turning off the attribution block in Claude Desktop's Code tab: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in the `env` of a Claude apps gateway's `code` policy
Added a field to the attribution block in Claude Code sessions behind a Claude apps gateway; remove the block with `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0`
Fixed the Claude apps gateway serving models that a policy's `availableModelsMatch: exact` or `deniedModels` blocks; it now answers 400 and leaves them out of its model lists

title.zh-TW: 自訂閘道連線逾時放寬，防止第三方金鑰洩漏
title.en: Custom Gateway Timeouts Relaxed to Prevent Third-Party Key Leakage

body.zh-TW: 串接自訂 API 閘道伺服器時，系統現在能更穩固地處理長連線與金鑰隔離。透過環境變數 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 轉發串流回覆時，等待資料抵達的逾時限制從 180 秒放寬至 300 秒，減少長思考過程被中途掐斷的機率。過去當自訂閘道的工作階段對話逼近 20 萬個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）時，容易誤判為長度過長而直接中斷，現在會正常送出請求。在安全性部分，先前向官方伺服器請求受控設定、功能旗標、個人資料或意見回饋時，曾發生誤將第三方閘道的金鑰一起送往官方伺服器的漏洞；現在這些請求已確實將第三方金鑰隔離，僅在必要時發送正確的官方金鑰。
body.en: When connecting custom API gateway servers, the system now provides more resilient handling for long-lived connections and API key isolation. Streaming responses routed through the `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` environment variable now have their data timeout extended from 180 seconds to 300 seconds, reducing the likelihood of long thinking processes getting cut off midstream. In the past, custom gateway sessions nearing 200,000 tokens were often mistakenly flagged as exceeding length limits and aborted; requests are now dispatched normally. On the security front, requests to official servers for managed settings, feature flags, profile data, or feedback previously suffered from a vulnerability that forwarded third-party gateway keys to official endpoints; those requests now strictly isolate third-party keys and transmit only the valid official keys when required.

items.original:
Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request
Fixed the server-managed settings request to Anthropic carrying a third-party gateway's API key when a managed settings file sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`
Fixed streams through a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` being aborted after 180 seconds with no data arriving; they now wait 300 seconds, whether or not feature flags are loaded
Fixed feature flag, startup, fast mode, profile and feedback requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); Anthropic API keys are still sent

title.zh-TW: 模組介面排版元件升級，色彩與邊框精準繪製
title.en: Module UI Layout Components Upgraded with Accurate Colors and Borders

body.zh-TW: 開發與執行擴充模組的介面時，排版彈性現在提高許多。模組的 `Text` 元件新增了 `size`、`weight`、`mono` 與 `tabular` 屬性，`Box` 元件也支援從 `xs` 到 `xl` 的具名間距級距，舊有的 `bold` 則改由 `weight` 取代。在終端機顯示上，`dimColor` 淡色文字在暗色 ANSI 主題與 16 色終端機下不再與一般文字混淆。在 VS Code 或文字模式 `claude -p` 等無法繪製面板的環境中，`$.ui.open` 不會再虛報面板已放置成功。模組透過 `$.ui.invalidate` 觸發重繪後，更新後的內容現在會在下一輪確實送交 Claude。此外，在外掛測試框架中比對介面樹狀結構時，根節點現已強制標記所屬外掛名稱。
body.en: When developing and rendering module interfaces, layout flexibility is now substantially improved. The module `Text` component introduces `size`, `weight`, `mono`, and `tabular` properties, while the `Box` component supports named spacing scales ranging from `xs` to `xl`, with the legacy `bold` property replaced by `weight`. On terminal displays, `dimColor` muted text is no longer conflated with standard text under dark ANSI themes and 16-color terminals. In environments incapable of rendering overlays, such as VS Code or text-mode `claude -p`, `$.ui.open` no longer falsely reports successful placement. When a module triggers a re-render via `$.ui.invalidate`, updated contents are now reliably delivered to Claude on the subsequent turn. Furthermore, when asserting UI trees in the plugin test framework, root nodes are now strictly labeled with their owning plugin name.

items.original:
Added `size`, `weight`, `mono` and `tabular` to a mod's `Text` and named spacing steps (`xs` to `xl`) to its `Box`; `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight`
Fixed a mod's `tool.describe` or `prompt.section` answer that changed after `$.ui.invalidate` never reaching Claude; the new answer is now sent on the next turn
Fixed `$.ui.open` reporting a mod's pane as placed in sessions where no surface draws it, such as Claude Code for VS Code and `claude -p`
Fixed a mod's `dimColor` text looking the same as plain text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals
Changed `ui.render` trees in `claude plugin test`: each mod's Box or Text root now carries `part: { plugin }` naming the mod, so exact-tree assertions must include it

title.zh-TW: 模組掛鉤擴充資料欄位，支援讀取媒體與身分
title.en: Module Hooks Expand Context Fields to Support Media and Identity Access

body.zh-TW: 受企業管控的擴充模組現在能從掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）中獲得更多上下文細節。在 `prompt.submit` 掛鉤中，你可以透過 `$.prompt.media` 直接讀取提示詞夾帶的圖片或文件原始資料。呼叫 `$.session.identity()` 則能獲取工作階段的登入方式、組織與電子郵件。針對技能呼叫，`skill.prompt` 掛鉤現在會收到該技能的前置設定資料、來源、外掛名稱與檔案路徑。此外，`session.append` 掛鉤新增了佇列入口，讓記錄在對話歷程中的佇列項目能與實際發送的內容做出區隔。而 `turn.start` 掛鉤不再只監聽主迴圈，也能藉由是否存在 `e.agentId` 來識別並監聽子代理或隊友的執行回合。
body.en: Enterprise-managed extension modules now receive richer contextual details from hooks. Inside the `prompt.submit` hook, you can access raw image and document attachments from prompts directly through `$.prompt.media`. Calling `$.session.identity()` retrieves the session login method, organization, and email address. For skill invocations, the `skill.prompt` hook now receives the skill frontmatter configuration data, source, plugin name, and file path. In addition, the `session.append` hook introduces a queue entry point, separating queued transcript items from dispatched content. The `turn.start` hook no longer listens exclusively to the main loop, allowing it to recognize and monitor subagent or teammate turns via the presence of `e.agentId`.

items.original:
Added `$.prompt.media` so a `prompt.submit` hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt
Added `$.session.identity()` for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed `forceLoginOrgUUID` lists that organization
Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives
Added a `queue` door to the `session.append` mod hook, so a mod can make the transcript's queue records differ from the prompt as sent
Changed the `turn.start` mod hook to also hear subagents' and teammates' turns, not only the main loop's; tell them apart by `e.agentId` (absent on the main loop)

title.zh-TW: 模組生命週期嚴格受控，修正背景無限迴圈
title.en: Module Lifecycle Strictly Governed to Eliminate Background Infinite Loops

body.zh-TW: 在無頭模式（headless，沒有視覺介面的執行模式）下執行自動化腳本時，模組的生命週期現在受到更嚴密的防護。以往若有模組在每回合結束時自動提交提示詞，曾發生無視 `--max-turns` 上限、預算限制或中斷訊號而持續運行的問題，現在這些限制會被強制遵守。當管理者從遠端停用模組時，進行中的工作階段會在回合交替時立刻卸載該模組。模組熱重載在重載失敗後若立刻存入修正，現在能正確觸發更新，且重複儲存未更動的檔案不再引發無謂重載。此外，跨檔案匯入函式傳遞物件被拒絕、模組掛鉤非同步等待外部作業引發無限重複執行，以及在特定路徑未經確認建立模組等異常，均已徹底修復。
body.en: When running automation scripts in headless mode, module lifecycles are now shielded by stricter safeguards. Previously, if a module automatically submitted prompts at the end of each turn, it could bypass `--max-turns` limits, budget constraints, or abort signals and keep running; these constraints are now enforced. When administrators remotely disable a module, active sessions unload it immediately at turn boundaries. If fixes are saved immediately after a hot-reload failure, hot reloading now triggers updates properly, and re-saving untouched files no longer sparks redundant reloads. Furthermore, issues where cross-file function imports rejected object passing, module hooks asynchronously awaiting external operations entered endless loops, and modules were created at specific paths without confirmation have all been thoroughly resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a mod that submits a prompt at the end of every turn keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, an interrupt, or the end of the host's conversation
Fixed the Write and Edit tools creating a mod in a session's mods folder without asking in accept-edits mode when the config directory's path has no `.claude` in it
Fixed installed mods that kept running in an open session after being turned off remotely; they now unload between turns
Fixed a mod hook, with or without a `.catch`, being run again without end when it waits on another mod's noun that does its work outside the call
Fixed a mod's hot reload ignoring a fix saved right after a failed reload; saving a mod file without changing it no longer reloads the mod
Fixed mods loaded from source files being refused when a hook hands `$` to a function declaration imported from another file of the mod

title.zh-TW: 外掛掛鉤深度防護上線，嚴密阻絕物件竄改
title.en: Plugin Hook Defense-in-Depth Arrives to Block Object Tampering

body.zh-TW: 擴充外掛傳遞複雜資料結構時，系統建立了全新的深度防禦機制。外掛掛鉤與工作流程腳本現在統一將傳回物件的巢狀層級上限收緊至 28,000 層，避免惡意或異常結構拖垮系統。當外掛掛鉤因異常無法接收或回傳結果時，原本具有攔截權限的動作將直接被拒絕執行而非放行；若工具已先行運作，其輸出結果也會被強制扣留。針對個別屬性取值引發錯誤時，系統不再整份拒絕物件，僅剔除出錯的鍵值。此外，內部資料傳遞不再偷偷抹除原型鍵值，確保工具安全檢查不被繞過；模組發起網路請求收到無內容的回應碼時，也不再因標頭長度誤判超標。
body.en: A new defense-in-depth mechanism is now in place when plugins pass complex data structures. Plugin hooks and workflow scripts now uniformly cap the nesting depth of returned objects at 28,000 levels, preventing malicious or abnormal structures from degrading the system. When a plugin hook fails to receive or return results due to an exception, actions with intercept permissions are directly blocked from running rather than allowed through. If a tool has already run, its output is also forcibly withheld. When retrieving an individual property triggers an error, the system no longer rejects the entire object and instead only removes the offending key. Additionally, internal data passing no longer silently strips prototype keys, ensuring tool security checks cannot be bypassed. When a module makes a network request and receives a no-content status code, it also no longer misreports header length limits as exceeded.

items.original:
Fixed plugin hooks being skipped when they pass a very deeply nested tool input or message on with next()
Fixed a value a mod's hook passes to `next()`, returns, or sends to a `$` method being refused whole when one of its getters throws a `RangeError`; now only that key is refused
Fixed mods' hooks being handed values with `__proto__` keys silently removed, which could skip a `tool.check` guard on a tool call another mod made
Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `304`, `204` or `205` response that declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit
Changed plugin hooks and workflow scripts to refuse values they hand back that nest deeper than 28,000 levels, with an error naming the limit (workflow scripts allowed 100,000)
Changed actions a plugin hook can block to be refused, not let through, when the hook cannot be handed them or cannot hand back its answer; a tool that already ran has its result withheld

title.zh-TW: 外掛評估支援排除工具，錯誤測試即刻判定不及格
title.en: Plugin Evaluation Adds Tool Exclusion and Fails Errored Tests Immediately

body.zh-TW: 在為外掛撰寫自動化測試與評估時，測試工具的精準度獲得了顯著改善。執行 `claude plugin eval` 時，現在能透過 `--disallow-tools` 參數或測試案例裡的 `disallowed_tools` 欄位，將特定的內建工具排除在評估流程之外。當評估過程遭遇 API 拒絕存取等錯誤時，該測試會直接判定為 0 分並以狀態碼 1 結束，不再僥倖判定為通過。在測試執行期間，若模組呼叫的服務方法在 10 秒內未給予回應，測試會比照工作階段直接判定失敗。同時，掛鉤的執行時間預算不再被背景持續呼叫所凍結。型別宣告檔位於特定路徑時驗證報錯，以及遙測事件誤報沒有掛鉤的問題也已一併修復。
body.en: Testing accuracy has improved significantly when writing automated tests and evaluations for plugins. When running `claude plugin eval`, you can now exclude specific built-in tools from the evaluation flow using the `--disallow-tools` flag or the `disallowed_tools` field in test cases. When an evaluation encounters errors such as API access denials, the test is immediately scored 0 and exits with status code 1, rather than passing by chance. During test runs, if a service method called by a module does not respond within 10 seconds, the test directly fails just like a regular session. Meanwhile, hook execution time budgets are no longer frozen by continuous background calls. Validation errors when type declaration files are located at specific paths, along with telemetry events falsely reporting no hooks, have also been fixed.

items.original:
Added `--disallow-tools` and a `disallowed_tools` case field to `claude plugin eval` to keep specific built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs
Fixed `claude plugin test` pausing a hook's time budget while a served `$` method it had called kept making `$` calls after answering
Fixed the `plugin_loaded` telemetry event reporting `has_hooks` as false for plugins whose hooks are a hooks module, built-in plugins included
Fixed `claude plugin eval` passing runs that the API refused: a run that ends on an API error now scores 0 without grading and makes the suite exit 1
Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting a mod's `$.state` references when `plugin.json` has no `types` key and the contract is at `./types/index.d.ts`
Changed `claude plugin test` to fail a call to a mod's served `$` method that has not answered within ten seconds, as a session does

title.zh-TW: 企業受控設定加強防護，嚴防外掛竄改環境路徑
title.en: Managed Enterprise Settings Strengthen Defenses Against Plugin Environment Tampering

body.zh-TW: 在受企業統一管轄的開發環境中，受控策略與外部模組的隔離更加嚴格。當組織集中管理 Claude Code 時，`/plugin` 指令與外掛驗證工具現在會主動列出哪些模組掛鉤會被略過。系統修補了沙盒環境中的指令得以寫入 `--plugin-dir` 資料夾的安全漏洞，防止外部未經驗證的程式碼藉由沙盒外重新載入而取得高權限執行。此外，使用者自行安裝的模組不再能透過設定環境變數影響企業受控命令的執行前綴，組織定義的權限規則與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具名稱也不再被本機模組覆蓋。透過本機裝置管理設定的強制登入組織與驗證方式，現在始終享有最高優先權。
body.en: Managed policies and external modules are now more strictly isolated in centrally governed enterprise development environments. When an organization manages Claude Code centrally, the `/plugin` command and plugin verification tools now proactively list which module hooks will be skipped. A vulnerability where commands inside the sandbox could write to the `--plugin-dir` folder has been patched, preventing unverified external code from gaining elevated execution privileges through reloads outside the sandbox. Furthermore, user-installed modules can no longer influence execution prefixes for enterprise-managed commands by setting environment variables. Organization-defined permission rules and MCP tool names can also no longer be overridden by local modules. Enforced login organizations and authentication methods configured through local device management now consistently receive top priority.

items.original:
Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin validate` naming a mod's hooks that are skipped where an organization manages Claude Code
Fixed a sandboxed shell command being able to write into a `--plugin-dir` folder, whose code Claude Code reloads and runs outside the sandbox
Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched when the stored login's plan was changed locally on machines whose MDM or managed-settings file sets `forceLoginOrgUUID`
Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceLoginMethod` from MDM or the managed-settings file being hidden or replaced by server-managed settings
Fixed a user-installed mod's `$.env.set` changing the environment or shell prefix that command hooks from managed settings start with
Improved enforcement of managed permission rules, managed hooks and organization MCP tool names against user-installed mods

title.zh-TW: 外掛製作流程指引更新，多終端安裝即刻同步
title.en: Plugin Authoring Flow Updated with Instant Multi-Terminal Sync

body.zh-TW: 開發與分享擴充外掛時，跨視窗同步與發布流程現在更加直覺。當你使用技能製作模組並準備發布時，Claude 現在會在建立 GitHub 儲存庫之前，先向你確認要設為公開還是私人專案，並且會主動檢查即將推送的檔案內容是否妥當。在多個終端機視窗並行作業的情境下，先前在另一個終端機剛剛安裝的新外掛，在當前視窗執行 `/reload-plugins` 時可能會抓不到，現在這項同步問題已經修復。⟦跟在共用工作室協作一樣，同伴剛剛在工具架上擺出新工具，你一轉頭就能順手取用，不必再特地走出大門重開一次工作室。⟧
body.en: Cross-window synchronization and publishing flows are now more intuitive when developing and sharing plugins. When creating a module using skills and preparing to publish, Claude now checks whether you want the project to be public or private before creating a GitHub repository, and proactively verifies whether the files about to be pushed are appropriate. When working across multiple terminal windows in parallel, newly installed plugins from another terminal could previously be missed when running `/reload-plugins` in your current window, but this sync issue is now resolved. ⟦In a shared workshop, the moment a partner sets a new tool on the rack, you can turn around and grab it immediately without stepping outside to reopen the shop.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/reload-plugins` not loading a plugin installed from another terminal a moment earlier
Improved the plugin-authoring skill's steps for sharing a mod: Claude asks public or private and checks the files before creating a GitHub repository

title.zh-TW: 沙盒符號連結漏洞修補，路徑通配比對更精準
title.en: Sandbox Symlink Flaws Patched with More Precise Path Wildcard Matching

body.zh-TW: 使用沙盒機制隔離執行指令時，系統修補了多項利用捷徑繞過管制的漏洞。在 macOS 上，沙盒指令過去曾藉由符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）找到目標真實路徑，進而讀寫被明確禁用的目錄，現在這類捷徑穿透已被阻斷。當沙盒允許讀寫的起始目錄在執行中被替換成符號連結時，權限規則會立即重新檢查。針對包含大括號、括號或反斜線等特殊字元的資料夾路徑，設定檔檢查與底層沙盒對萬用字元的解讀現在已完全一致。在 Linux 環境下，若指令在展開萬用字元讀取規則時耗時較長，使用者也能正常按下 Esc 或 Ctrl-C 隨時中斷操作。
body.en: Several vulnerabilities that exploited shortcuts to bypass controls while running commands in an isolated sandbox have been patched. On macOS, sandboxed commands could previously follow symbolic links to resolve real target paths and read or write explicitly forbidden directories, but such traversal is now blocked. If a root directory permitted for sandbox read and write access is replaced with a symbolic link during execution, permission rules are immediately re-evaluated. For directory paths containing special characters such as braces, brackets, or backslashes, configuration checks and the underlying sandbox now interpret wildcards in complete alignment. Under Linux, if a command takes a long time to expand wildcard read rules, users can press Esc or Ctrl-C normally to cancel the operation at any time.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands on macOS being able to read or write a denied path by its real location when the denied path passes through a symlink
Fixed sandbox `denyRead` and `allowRead` globs with braces, parentheses or backslashes in a folder's name being read differently by Claude Code's settings checks than by the sandbox
Fixed sandbox glob `allowRead` and `allowWrite` entries not being re-checked when the directory they start from is replaced by a symlink
Improved sandboxed Bash on Linux: Esc and Ctrl-C now work while wildcard read rules are being expanded for a command

title.zh-TW: 沙盒跨平台相容修復，設定無法儲存時明確報錯
title.en: Cross-Platform Sandbox Compatibility Fixed with Clear Errors on Failed Configuration Saves

body.zh-TW: 在不同作業系統上啟動沙盒時，邊界環境的設定儲存與目錄權限修復完畢。在 WSL2（Windows 上的 Linux 子系統）環境下，當沙盒具備 Windows 磁碟的寫入權限時，過去曾因目錄建立失敗報錯而卡住，現在已能正常執行。在 Linux 系統上，沙盒指令結束後若在設定目錄留下空白檔案，先前會導致登入狀態、伺服器清單與專案信任紀錄看起來全部丟失，這項顯示異常已修復。另外，若專案資料夾本身為唯讀而無法寫入設定，輸入 `/sandbox` 過去會虛報成功，現在會誠實告知設定未變更以及具體原因。以前遇到權限受阻時容易讓人摸不著頭緒，現在所有狀態都如實呈現。
body.en: Configuration saving and directory permissions in boundary environments are now fixed when launching the sandbox across different operating systems. In WSL2 environments where the sandbox has write permissions to Windows drives, directory creation failures previously halted execution, but it now runs properly. On Linux, if a sandboxed command left empty files in the configuration directory upon exiting, login states, server lists, and project trust records previously appeared entirely lost, a display issue that is now resolved. In addition, if a project folder is read-only and prevents writing settings, running `/sandbox` previously reported a false success, but it now accurately reports that settings were unchanged along with the specific reason. While blocked permissions previously caused confusion, all statuses are now reported faithfully.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands failing on WSL2 with `bwrap: Can't mkdir /mnt/c/Program Files/ClaudeCode` when the sandbox can write to the Windows drive
Fixed sign-in, MCP servers and project trust appearing lost on Linux after a sandboxed command left an empty `.config.json` in the config directory
Fixed `/sandbox` reporting success when its setting could not be saved because the project folder is not writable; it now says nothing changed and why

title.zh-TW: 外部工具伺服器命名防護，權限比對不再混淆
title.en: External Tool Server Name Protection Prevents Permission Matching Confusion

body.zh-TW: 當你替專案配置多個擴充服務並設定存取規則時，不再會因為特殊字元或縮寫而套用到錯誤目標。在設定檔中若 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器恰好命名為 `constructor`、`prototype` 或 `toString` 等 JavaScript 保留關鍵字，過去會無法連線或在自動授權模式下反覆跳出確認視窗，現在已恢復正常。同時，權限規則對名稱的匹配不再寬鬆放行：例如規則 `mcp__a` 過去會誤讓名稱為 `a__b` 或 `a_` 的伺服器一同通過，現在僅嚴格允許名稱完全吻合的目標，若要涵蓋全部工具必須寫成完整名稱 `mcp__<server>__*`。若伺服器名稱本身包含雙底線，詢問與阻擋規則現在也能正確生效，不再因為底線切割而失效。
body.en: When configuring multiple extension services and setting access rules for a project, rules will no longer apply to the wrong target due to special characters or abbreviations. In configuration files, if an MCP server happens to be named after a JavaScript reserved keyword like `constructor`, `prototype`, or `toString`, connections previously failed or repeatedly prompted confirmation dialogs in auto-approve mode, but this now works normally. At the same time, permission rules no longer match names loosely. For example, rule `mcp__a` previously allowed servers named `a__b` or `a_` to pass by mistake, but it now strictly permits only exact name matches. Covering all tools now requires the full pattern `mcp__<server>__*`. If a server name itself contains `__`, prompt and block rules now also take effect correctly without breaking when the name is split at that point.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers named `constructor` or `prototype` in an MCP config never being connected
Fixed tools of an MCP server named `constructor` or `toString` asking for permission in auto mode and bypass permissions mode
Fixed deny and ask rules for an MCP server (`mcp__<server>`) not applying when the server's normalized name contains a double underscore
Fixed `--bare` sessions leaving out an MCP server named `constructor` or `prototype` that `--channels` asked for
Changed MCP allow rules to reach only the server they name: `mcp__a` no longer allows a server named `a__b` or `a_`; write `mcp__<server>__*` with the server's whole normalized name
Changed agent `tools:` lists to take only the named MCP server's tools; list a server whose name contains `__` as `mcp__<whole name>__*`

title.zh-TW: 外部協定支援新版協商，長文字描述不再截斷
title.en: External Protocol Adds Modern Negotiation and Preserves Long Descriptions

body.zh-TW: 透過網路連接外部工具時，通訊連線與資料傳遞的完整性獲得顯著提升。在雲端工作階段與遠端連線中，連線器預設將自動協商最新的 2026-07-28 協定版本。官方第一方伺服器的工具說明與指示文字，原本在超過 4,096 個字元時會被無情切斷，現在會完整傳遞給 Claude。進行身分驗證或更新 token（授權令牌）時，系統現在會如實送出自訂的標頭資訊，避免企業反向代理伺服器阻擋。針對 HTTP 連線收到通知時伺服器未結尾導致連線卡死 30 秒、背景重新連線導致工具呼叫重複執行或失敗，以及未經驗證的 HTTP 轉址問題，均已在此次更新中一併排除。
body.en: Communication connections and data integrity have improved markedly when connecting to external tools over the network. In cloud sessions and remote connections, connectors now automatically negotiate the latest 2026-07-28 protocol version by default. Tool descriptions and instructions from official first-party servers, which were previously cut off past 4,096 characters, are now delivered in full to Claude. When authenticating or refreshing tokens, the system now faithfully sends custom headers to prevent enterprise reverse proxies from blocking requests. Issues where HTTP connections hung for 30 seconds due to unclosed server notifications, background reconnections caused duplicate or failing tool calls, and unverified HTTP redirects occurred have all been resolved in this update.

items.original:
Fixed MCP connections over HTTP hanging for 30 seconds and failing when a server never ends the body of its reply to a notification (anthropics/claude-code#99014)
Fixed MCP tool calls in headless and SDK sessions sometimes failing or running twice when a background reconnect closed the connection they were running on
Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in, token refresh and sign-out not sending configured `headers`/`headersHelper` values, which broke servers behind an authenticating proxy
Changed requests to claude.ai's connector proxy and to Anthropic-hosted MCP servers to no longer follow HTTP redirects; redirects by a connector's own server are unaffected
Changed cloud session and Remote Control MCP connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
Changed MCP tool descriptions and server instructions from Anthropic's first-party MCP servers at `api.anthropic.com` to reach Claude in full instead of being cut at 4,096 characters

title.zh-TW: 外部設定解析修正，未授權伺服器不再暗中啟動
title.en: External Configuration Parsing Fixed to Stop Covert Launches of Unauthorized Servers

body.zh-TW: 管理外部工具的設定清單時，格式驗證與啟動防護更加安全。現在當專案中的 `.mcp.json` 內容為空時，`claude mcp list`、`claude doctor` 與 `/status` 不再把它誤報為無效設定。如果設定檔裡的啟用清單只填寫單一伺服器名稱字串，整份檔案也不會再被忽略。在安全防護方面，當被安全性策略阻擋的伺服器遭到查詢或動態載入時，系統現在會在連線前就直接標記為受阻，絕不再暗中將其啟動或建立連線。此外，執行 `claude mcp add` 加入指令時，若指令結尾包含 `--background`，系統不會再誤把新增指令本身當成背景工作階段執行。以前設定檔格式稍微精簡就容易失效，現在容錯率高且安全把關嚴密。
body.en: Format validation and launch guards are now safer when managing configuration lists for external tools. When `.mcp.json` in a project is empty, `claude mcp list`, `claude doctor`, and `/status` no longer misreport it as an invalid configuration. If the enabled list in a configuration file contains only a single server name string, the entire file is no longer ignored. On the security side, when a server blocked by a security policy is queried or dynamically loaded, the system now marks it as blocked prior to connecting and never launches it or establishes a connection covertly. Furthermore, when adding a command with `claude mcp add`, if the command ends with `--background`, the system no longer mistakes the add command itself for a background session. Where slightly condensed configuration formats once failed easily, fault tolerance is now high alongside strict security checks.

items.original:
Fixed `claude mcp list`, `claude doctor` and `/status` reporting an empty `.mcp.json` as invalid
Fixed a settings file being ignored when `enabledMcpjsonServers` or `disabledMcpjsonServers` held a single server name (letters, digits, - or _) as a plain string
Fixed MCP servers added to a running headless or SDK session being connected before some policy checks ran; a blocked server is now reported as failed without being contacted
Fixed `claude mcp list`, `claude mcp get` and subagent MCP servers starting a server that a policy check blocks; it is now reported as blocked without being started
Fixed `claude mcp add <name> -- <command> --background` being started as a background session

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控佇列穩定提升，慢速網路不再畫面凍結
title.en: Remote Control Queue Stability Enhanced to Prevent UI Freezes on Slow Networks

body.zh-TW: 從網頁端使用遠端遙控（Remote Control）操控本機終端機時，連線佇列的傳輸韌性更加穩固。在網路連線不穩或頻寬較慢的環境下，大量事件資料無法及時上傳時曾導致網頁畫面完全凍結，現在這類卡死狀況已經修復。當整批排隊等待的提示詞中有一則發送失敗時，同批次的其他提示詞不再會無故被整批丟棄。若使用者手動按下停止（Stop）中斷了下一則提示詞的檢查，前一則已經順利通過檢查的提示詞也能如實保留在歷史紀錄中。另外，使用方向鍵停留在佇列訊息上方時，介面現在會明確解釋停留原因。執行清除重置後再恢復舊工作階段，也不會再發生錯連到清除後新工作階段的靈異現象。
body.en: Transmission resilience in the connection queue is sturdier when using Remote Control from the web to operate a local terminal. Under unstable network connections or slower bandwidth, heavy event uploads previously caused the web UI to freeze completely, but these lockups are now resolved. When one prompt in a queued batch fails to send, other prompts in the same batch are no longer discarded for no reason. If a user manually presses Stop to interrupt checks on the next prompt, the prior prompt that already passed checks is properly preserved in history. In addition, when hovering over queued messages with arrow keys, the interface now clearly explains why the pause occurred. Restoring an old session after a clear reset also no longer glitches into the newly cleared session.

items.original:
Fixed the claude.ai view of a Remote Control or cloud session freezing when a large batch of events could not finish uploading over a slow connection
Fixed a Remote Control prompt being lost when another queued prompt in the same batch failed to deliver
Fixed a Remote Control prompt that had passed its hooks being dropped from prompt history when Stop interrupted the next queued prompt's hook
Fixed `←` not saying why it stayed put over a queued message while Remote Control is on
Fixed resuming a conversation from before `/clear` reattaching to the Remote Control session of the conversation after it

title.zh-TW: 遠端傳送大檔正常送達，相片本機存檔不卡關
title.en: Large Remote Files Deliver Reliably While Local Photo Caching No Longer Blocks

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端遙控發送多媒體檔案時，傳輸遺失的漏洞已全部補齊。當你從手機或遠端網頁介面上傳照片時，即便電腦端本機暫存複本因磁碟或權限問題無法儲存，Claude 現在依然能正常接收並看見該張照片。在長時間持續運行的遠端工作階段中，先前偶爾會發生傳送的檔案憑空消失、Claude 完全沒收到的狀況，現在檔案送達的可靠性已獲得修正。此外，大小落在 30 到 35 MiB 之間的大型檔案，過去在傳送至遠端遙控或雲端工作階段時會卡住無法送達，現在這類體積的大檔案也能順暢上傳。以前跨裝置傳大檔或照片容易漏接，現在每次發送都能確實抵達。
body.en: Transfer loss bugs when sending multimedia files via remote control have now been resolved. When you upload photos from a phone or the remote web interface, Claude can now properly receive and view the image even if local caching on your computer fails due to disk space or permission issues. In long-running remote sessions, delivered files that previously vanished into thin air without reaching Claude are now reliably delivered. Furthermore, large files between 30 and 35 MiB that previously stalled when sent to remote control or cloud sessions now upload smoothly. Cross-device transfers for large files and photos previously dropped packets easily, but every transmission now arrives as expected.

items.original:
Fixed photos sent over Remote Control being dropped when their copy could not be saved on your computer; Claude now still sees the photo
Fixed files sent over Remote Control sometimes not arriving in long-running sessions
Fixed files of 30 to 35 MiB sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session not arriving

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段連線阻擋修復，登入過期引導重登
