title.en: Cloud Session Connection Blocks Resolved with Clear Relogin Guidance

body.zh-TW: 連線至雲端工作階段遇到存取受阻時，系統現在能給出更正確的錯誤指引。如果因為網頁端登入憑證失效或被拒絕而無法連線，畫面現在會清楚提示具體原因，並指引你使用 `claude auth login` 重新登入。當你透過金鑰輔助工具（`apiKeyHelper`）帶入金鑰且連線遭拒時，錯誤訊息不再張冠李戴指向錯誤的企業組織名稱。在介面顯示方面，先前在工具組單行標籤展開後，偶爾會在標籤後方多餘露出模型接續產生的內部文字，現在這些排版干擾已經清理乾淨。以前登入遇到狀況往往只能看著模糊的報錯乾著急，現在每一條阻擋訊息都清楚告訴你下一步該如何處理。
body.en: When access to a cloud session is blocked, the system now provides more accurate error guidance. If a connection fails because web login credentials have expired or been rejected, the screen now clearly explains the specific reason and directs you to run `claude auth login` to authenticate again. When you supply a key through `apiKeyHelper` and the connection is denied, error messages no longer point to the wrong organization name. On the interface side, internal model text that previously leaked behind expanded single-line toolset labels has been cleaned up. Login issues that previously left you stranded with vague errors now provide clear next steps for every blocked request.

items.original:
Fixed the error for a denied cloud session, which could point to the wrong organization when a key from `apiKeyHelper` was in use
Fixed cloud sessions sometimes showing the model's follow-up text after a tool group's one-line label
Improved the error shown when a cloud session is refused because your claude.ai login was rejected or has expired: it now tells you to sign in again with `claude auth login`

title.zh-TW: 雲端背景工作單元替換，回覆中斷與重複通通修好
title.en: Cloud Worker Replacements Stabilized to Prevent Lost or Duplicated Responses

body.zh-TW: 在雲端執行長對話時，背景工作單元（worker）更換時的回覆更為穩定。雲端工作階段的背景工作單元被換掉的那一刻，以前如果恰好碰上使用者回覆授權詢問、對話剛完成壓縮，或是輸出剛好碰觸到 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限，系統容易遺失當前狀態，導致訊息被已讀不回或輸出停滯在半空中。現在這些中斷的回答都能順利接續。同時，若在工具執行完畢且同時載入技能的關鍵步驟重啟工作階段，也不會再發生把早已完成的回合又重新重複回答一次的狀況。以前替換時容易卡死，現在交接過程順暢無痕。
body.en: Responses during long conversations in the cloud are now more stable when background workers are replaced. Previously, if a cloud session worker was swapped right as a user answered an authorization prompt, context was compacted, or output reached the token limit, the system could lose its state and drop the message or stall the response. These interrupted turns now resume smoothly. Additionally, restarting a session during the critical step where a tool finishes running while skills are being loaded no longer causes previously completed turns to be repeated. Transitions that once froze operations now proceed seamlessly.

items.original:
Fixed a cloud session sometimes ignoring the answer to a permission prompt or a question when the answer was given while the session's worker was being replaced
Fixed a cloud session leaving a reply unfinished when its worker was replaced just after the reply hit the output token limit
Fixed cloud sessions sometimes leaving a message unanswered when the worker was replaced right after a compaction
Fixed cloud sessions and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` sometimes answering a finished turn again after a restart, when a tool ended the turn and a skill loaded in the same step

title.zh-TW: 協作工作階段同步修復，自動模式權限嚴格把關
title.en: Cowork Session Sync Fixed Alongside Stricter Auto Mode Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在團隊協作（Cowork）雲端工作階段中，外掛跨裝置同步與授權防護機制全面優化。你在另一台裝置上對外掛進行的更新、停用或刪除，進行中的協作工作階段現在能及時生效，不再執著於舊版本直到重開。啟動時多個處理程序同步外掛所產生的路徑未找到假警報也已排除。在權限控管上，自動模式下的權限掛鉤（PermissionRequest）不再被允許自動核准終端機指令或衍生子代理，這類高風險操作必須等待人工授權或直接被拒絕。而在非自動模式下使用瀏覽器擴充功能時，若安全分類器標記了已核准網站的動作，系統會改為主動向你確認而非直接拒絕。此外，前版中中途停止導致編輯重試失敗的問題也已修好。
body.en: Plugin synchronization and authorization safeguards across devices have been comprehensively improved in Cowork cloud sessions. Updates, disabling, or deletions made to plugins on another device now take effect immediately in active collaborative sessions instead of clinging to old versions until a restart. False path-not-found warnings triggered by multiple processes syncing plugins during startup have also been eliminated. For permission control, PermissionRequest hooks in auto mode are no longer allowed to automatically approve terminal commands or spawned subagents, requiring manual approval or outright rejection for such high-risk operations. When using browser extensions in non-auto mode, actions flagged by security classifiers on approved websites now prompt you for confirmation rather than being rejected immediately. In addition, an issue from the previous version where stopping mid-stream caused edit retries to fail has been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions failing on a message stopped while its `UserPromptSubmit` or mod `prompt.submit` hooks were still running (regression in 2.1.296)
Fixed a spurious "synced[0] commands path not found" plugin error at startup when another Claude Code process had just updated a claude.ai-synced plugin
Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying on an old account plugin after a plugin reload that timed out or a restart that reused a recent sync
Fixed Cowork cloud sessions running the old version of an account plugin changed, removed or disabled from another device until the session restarted
Changed Claude in Chrome in Cowork cloud sessions outside auto mode: an approved-site action the safety classifier flags now asks you instead of being refused, unless managed settings apply
Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a `PermissionRequest` hook can no longer approve shell commands or subagents; those prompts wait or are denied

title.zh-TW: 終端機寬字元換行校正，表情符號不再多餘斷行
title.en: Terminal Wide Character Wrapping Fixed to Prevent Extra Emoji Line Breaks

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中閱讀中日韓文字（CJK）與表情符號交雜的內容時，畫面排版現在更加平整。過去在特定視窗寬度下，中英夾雜或帶有表情圖示的段落換行時，最後一行文字偶爾會無端消失，或者在下方留下突兀的空白行；在極度狹窄的視窗或單格寬度欄位中，這類雙倍寬度字元也容易引發多餘空行。此外，當文字在寬字元旁邊截斷時，容易出現留下空白格子或被錯誤截斷兩次的問題，表情符號內部遇到顏色屬性切換時圖案憑空消失的臭蟲也已解決。⟦好比報紙排版工人的鉛字模具，以前遇到雙倍寬度的特殊圖章容易算錯行寬而擠掉下一排字，現在每枚鉛字的占位都計算得分毫不差。⟧
body.en: Terminal layouts are now much cleaner when viewing content that mixes Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) characters with emojis. Previously, at specific window widths, paragraphs with mixed scripts or emojis would occasionally drop their final line during wrapping or leave an unexpected blank line below. In extremely narrow windows or single-column fields, these double-width characters could also trigger superfluous line breaks. Additionally, truncating text adjacent to wide characters previously left empty cells or caused text to be truncated twice, and an issue where emojis vanished when switching color attributes has also been fixed. ⟦A print typesetter setting movable lead blocks once miscalculated line widths around double-width stamps and crowded out the next row of text, but now every character block is measured with exact precision.⟧

items.original:
Fixed wrapped text mixing CJK or emoji with Latin words losing its last line or leaving a blank row at some terminal widths
Fixed blank rows appearing under CJK and emoji text squeezed into a one-cell column, as in a very narrow terminal
Fixed text cut in the middle beside wide characters leaving a cell unused or being cut twice, and an emoji vanishing where a color changed inside it

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕互動不再誤縮，表格巢狀樣式維持邊框
title.en: Fullscreen Terminal Interactions Prevent Accidental Collapse While Table Borders Stay Intact

body.zh-TW: 在終端機全螢幕模式下檢視對話紀錄時，選取文字與格式呈現更加穩定。現在雙擊展開行中的單字會精準選取該單字，不再誤將整行折疊收起。當系統在閒置時提示輸入指令以節省 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）時，新版本安裝完成的通知會並排顯示於提示旁，不再被擋住。在排版樣式上，表格內部粗體、斜體等巢狀文字樣式先前在遇到自動換行時，常會破壞表格邊框或丟失樣式，現在已能維持邊框完整。此外，在不支援括號貼上模式的終端機裡貼入大段文字時，遇到全形引號等不可見控制字元時文字被整批截斷的重大問題，也已徹底修復。以前看長紀錄容易誤觸折疊或排版跑版，現在互動體驗順暢自然。
body.en: Text selection and formatting are now far more stable when reviewing conversation logs in fullscreen terminal mode. Double-clicking a word in an expanded line now precisely highlights that word instead of accidentally collapsing the entire line. When the system prompts for commands while idle to save tokens, notifications for newly installed versions now appear side by side next to the prompt without being obscured. In formatting layouts, nested text styles like bold and italics inside tables previously broke borders or lost formatting during text wrapping, but borders are now preserved intact. Furthermore, pasting large blocks of text into terminals without bracketed paste mode support previously truncated text upon encountering invisible control characters such as full-width quotes, which has now been resolved. Reviewing long histories no longer risks accidental folding or layout glitches.

items.original:
Fixed double-clicking a word in an expanded transcript row in fullscreen mode collapsing the row instead of selecting the word
Fixed the fullscreen "Update installed" notice being hidden behind the idle "/clear to save tokens" hint; it now shows beside the hint
Fixed bold, italic and other nested text styles running over table borders or being lost on wrapped rows
Fixed long pastes in terminals without bracketed paste losing all text after an invisible control character, such as a mis-decoded curly quote

title.zh-TW: 除錯日誌記憶體洩漏修復，多子代理重啟無負擔
title.en: Debug Log Memory Leaks Resolved with Light Resumptions for Multiple Subagents

body.zh-TW: 長時間開啟除錯模式或呼叫多個代理人時，記憶體佔用過高的狀況獲得了徹底根治。在開啟 `--debug` 或 `--debug-file` 記錄大量日誌時，過去記憶體會隨著輸出持續膨脹；若儲存日誌的磁碟或網路掛載點突然停止寫入，程式在結束退出時還會陷入死當，現在這兩項問題都已修復。當除錯輸出導向標準錯誤輸出，而外部父行程停止讀取串流時，記憶體也不會再毫無上限地暴增。此外，在遠端遙控或雲端環境中，如果一個工作階段先前曾派生執行過大量子代理（subagent），以往重新連線恢復該工作階段時會瞬間吃掉巨量記憶體。這個問題已經修好，恢復後記憶體不再飆高。
body.en: Excessive memory consumption during extended debug sessions or when spawning multiple agents has been resolved. When logging heavily with `--debug` or `--debug-file`, memory previously expanded continuously with output volume, and the application could freeze upon exit if the disk or network mount storing logs stopped accepting writes; both issues are now fixed. When debug output is redirected to standard error and an external parent process stops reading the stream, memory no longer balloons indefinitely. Additionally, in remote control or cloud environments, reconnecting to resume a session that previously spawned numerous subagents no longer triggers a sudden memory spike. Reconnecting now keeps memory usage steady.

items.original:
Fixed memory growth under heavy debug logging (`--debug`, `--debug-file`), and a hang on exit when the debug log is on a disk or network mount that stops accepting writes
Fixed memory growing without bound when debug output goes to stderr and the parent process stops reading it
Fixed high memory use after resuming a cloud or Remote Control session that had run many subagents

title.zh-TW: 授權詢問不再誤送確認，多行提示保留換行格式
title.en: Approval Prompts Prevent Accidental Confirmation While Multiline Inputs Keep Line Breaks

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機裡打字與系統互動時，多項輸入誤觸與格式拼接的問題均已修復。過去當你在輸入框打字尚未送出時，背後若剛好彈出授權確認或提問，按下的 Enter 鍵容易不小心把該詢問直接確認掉，現在系統會保護輸入狀態不被誤觸。透過串流 JSON 格式發送多個排隊內容區塊時，合併為同一回合的訊息不再黏在一起，會保留清楚的換行符號。如果對背景工作階段輸入 `--bg` 或 `--background` 等文字內容，系統不再誤把文字當成指令參數而重複開啟新工作階段。此外，包含特殊鍵盤符號表情圖示的授權說明文字不再提前換行截斷，自訂指令內嵌的指令碼在被新訊息中斷時也不會再重複跑兩次。
body.en: Multiple input handling and formatting concatenation issues when typing in the terminal have been fixed. Previously, if an authorization confirmation or prompt appeared while you were typing in the input box, pressing Enter could accidentally confirm the prompt; the system now protects your active input state against accidental submission. When sending queued content blocks via streaming JSON, messages merged into the same turn no longer run together and now preserve distinct line breaks. Typing literal text like `--bg` or `--background` into a background session is no longer misinterpreted as command flags that spawn duplicate sessions. In addition, authorization descriptions containing special keyboard symbol emojis no longer break lines prematurely, and scripts embedded in custom commands no longer run twice if interrupted by incoming messages.

items.original:
Fixed Enter answering a question or permission prompt that had been held back while you typed an unsent message
Fixed queued prompts sent as content blocks over `--input-format stream-json` running together without a line break when merged into one turn
Fixed permission prompts cutting off or wrapping too early when the reason text contains keycap or joined emoji
Fixed a prompt or reply of `--bg` or `--background` to a background session being taken for the flag, which could start new sessions over and over instead of delivering it
Fixed a custom slash command's embedded shell line running twice when a newer message interrupted the command while its prompt was being checked

title.zh-TW: 側邊提問不再重置畫面，非互動模式超時即刻返回
title.en: Side Inquiries Keep Scroll Position Steady While Non-Interactive Modes Timeout Promptly

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/btw` 向 Claude 提出額外的旁支問題時，畫面捲動與超時防護更加完善。在終端機全螢幕模式下向上捲動查看歷史紀錄時，如果中途輸入 `/btw` 提問，畫面過去會冷不防被強制拉回最底端，現在捲動位置會固定在原地不受干擾。在自動化執行的非互動式工作階段中，先前發起的 `/btw` 提問若在工作階段結束前未被處理，常會遺留在背景甚至在收到相同請求時重複執行第二次；現在工作階段結束時會立刻取消未完提問。同時，非互動模式下的 `/btw` 提問如果超過 11 分鐘仍未獲得回應，系統會主動回傳逾時錯誤不再無限等待。以前提問容易打斷看紀錄的節奏，現在安靜又守時。
body.en: Screen scrolling and timeout protections when asking side questions with `/btw` have been significantly refined. When scrolling up through history in fullscreen terminal mode, asking a question with `/btw` previously forced the view back to the bottom, but the scroll position now stays firmly in place. In automated non-interactive sessions, pending `/btw` queries that were left unprocessed when a session ended previously lingered in the background or ran a second time upon receiving an identical request; unfinished questions are now promptly canceled upon session exit. Furthermore, `/btw` queries in non-interactive mode that receive no response after 11 minutes now return an explicit timeout error rather than waiting indefinitely. Asking questions no longer interrupts your scrolling rhythm.

items.original:
Fixed `/btw` jumping the transcript to the bottom when asked while scrolled up in fullscreen
Fixed `/btw` side questions in non-interactive sessions not being cancelled when the session ends, and running a second time when the same request arrived again mid-run
Changed `/btw` side questions in non-interactive sessions to return a timeout error when still unanswered after 11 minutes

title.zh-TW: 技能指令加強字元過濾，掛鉤執行順序重新釐定
title.en: Skill Commands Strengthen Character Filtering as Hook Execution Order Is Clarified

body.zh-TW: 自訂技能（Skill）與斜線指令的載入機制進行了多項安全防護。檔案或資料夾名稱若夾帶隱藏字元、轉向控制字元、空白字元或角括號等危險符號，系統會直接拒絕載入該技能直至更名。在掛鉤執行順序上，`UserPromptSubmit` 掛鉤現在會搶在技能或指令展開前優先執行，如果掛鉤阻擋了提示詞，其內部嵌入的終端機命令也會一併被安全攔截。此外，使用 `/reload-skills` 時會清楚提示它會將完整技能清單重新發送，是長對話壓縮後召回遺失技能的最佳方式。呼叫未知技能時若誤加前綴，系統會主動建議正確名稱。以 / 開頭、用 Agent SDK 的 `verbatimPrompts` 選項送出的提示詞，在重啟後不會再被誤當成斜線指令執行。
body.en: Loading mechanisms for custom skills and slash commands now feature several security protections. If a file or folder name contains hidden characters, bidirectional control characters, whitespace, or angle brackets, the system rejects loading the skill until it is renamed. In terms of hook order, the `UserPromptSubmit` hook now executes before skills or commands expand, ensuring that terminal commands embedded inside a prompt are safely intercepted if the hook blocks it. In addition, running `/reload-skills` now clearly explains that it resends the full skill list, making it the recommended way to restore missing skills after context compaction. Calling an unknown skill with an accidental prefix now prompts the system to suggest the correct name. Finally, prompts beginning with / sent using the Agent SDK `verbatimPrompts` option are no longer mistakenly executed as slash commands after a restart.

items.original:
Fixed a prompt starting with `/`, sent with the Agent SDK's `verbatimPrompts` option, running as a slash command when `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-ran it after a restart
Improved the Skill tool's "Unknown skill" error to suggest a skill's listed name when Claude wrongly adds the `anthropic-skills:` prefix to it
Improved `/reload-skills` to say it re-sends the full skill list to Claude, which is how to get skills back after compaction
Changed skill and command loading: one whose file or folder name has hidden, direction-changing or blank-like characters, `<` or `>` is no longer offered until renamed; such a `name:` is ignored
Changed `UserPromptSubmit` hooks to run before a skill or custom slash command expands, so a hook that blocks the prompt now also stops its embedded shell commands
Changed a skill's own front-matter `UserPromptSubmit` hook to first run on the prompt after the one that invokes the skill

title.zh-TW: 工作樹隔離防護加固，空倉庫與殘留目錄修復
title.en: Worktree isolation guards reinforced, empty repos and leftover dirs fixed

body.zh-TW: 利用 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行隔離作業時，系統的容錯與清理機制更加可靠。在具備隔離保護的工作階段中，安全防護層先前會意外放行某些特定 awk 腳本，現在這些可能突破邊界的程式碼已確實被攔截拒絕。在採用新版 reftable 格式儲存參照的 Git 儲存庫中，結束工作階段後留置在內部的殘留資料夾現在能正常清理乾淨。如果因為儲存庫尚未有任何提交紀錄而導致基底無法解析，或是嘗試在裸儲存庫（bare repository）的根目錄建立工作樹，錯誤訊息不再丟出艱澀的底層代碼，而是明確說明檔案結構與具體原因。以前遇到失敗難以除錯，現在提示清楚又好懂。
body.en: When running isolated tasks with Git worktree (the ability to check out multiple branches of the same project simultaneously), fault tolerance and cleanup mechanics are now far more dependable. In sessions protected by isolation barriers, security filters previously let certain specific awk scripts slip past; these boundary-crossing operations are now reliably intercepted and blocked. In Git repositories storing references with the new reftable format, leftover directories abandoned inside upon exiting a session are now purged cleanly. If a base revision cannot resolve because the repository has no commits yet, or if you attempt to create a worktree at the root of a bare repository, the error message replaces cryptic low-level codes with a clear explanation of the directory layout and root cause. Troubleshooting setup failures used to be baffling, but now the diagnostics are transparent and simple.

items.original:
Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some awk programs the isolation guard should refuse
Fixed `--worktree` sessions leaving a folder behind in `.git/worktrees` in repositories using git's reftable ref storage
Improved the error shown when a worktree cannot be created because its base commit does not resolve: it now says how the lookup ended and the likely reasons, such as a repository without a commit
Improved the error for creating a worktree at a bare-repository layout's root: it now explains the layout instead of an unrelated git error

title.zh-TW: 工作階段回復指令縮短，程式庫檢查不再盲目全加
title.en: Session resume command shortened, code review no longer suggests add dot

body.zh-TW: 退出 Claude Code 時，終端機印出的重新連線指令現在更安全且更簡潔。程式退出時提供的恢復指令改為固定採用工作階段 ID 識別，不再使用可能包含特殊字元的自訂名稱，杜絕直接貼上指令時發生非預期程式碼執行的風險。在工作樹工作階段結束時，若螢幕寬度不足以容納完整參數，指令會自動縮短使用 `-w` 與 `-r` 縮寫；若仍放不下則會在上方提示適合執行的目錄位置。此外，執行程式碼審查指令 `/ultrareview` 遭遇上傳阻礙時，錯誤訊息不再草率建議讀者執行 `git add .`，避免不小心把敏感的環境設定檔誤加入暫存區。以前複製指令心驚膽跳，現在處處設有防護線。
body.en: When exiting Claude Code, the reconnect instructions printed to your terminal are now safer and more concise. Resume commands given on exit now consistently stick to session IDs instead of custom names that might contain special characters, eliminating the risk of accidental code execution when pasting them directly into your shell. At the end of a worktree session, if terminal width cannot fit full parameters, commands automatically abbreviate using `-w` and `-r` flags; if space remains too tight, a tip above points out the best directory to run them from. Furthermore, when the code review command `/ultrareview` encounters upload hurdles, error output stops carelessly recommending `git add .`, preventing sensitive environment configuration files from being accidentally staged into your commit index. Copying exit commands used to feel risky, but safeguards are now embedded at every step.

items.original:
Changed the resume command printed at exit: it names the session by its ID and no longer by its name, so that nothing in a session name can run when the line is pasted
Changed the resume command printed at exit of a worktree session: it uses `-w` and `-r` if the long flags do not fit the terminal. If neither fits a kept worktree, rows above it say where to run it
Changed the errors shown when `/ultrareview` can't upload a repository to stop suggesting `git add .`, which could stage or commit untracked files such as `.env`

title.zh-TW: 訊息附件遺漏修復，超大圖片不再引發連續報錯
title.en: Message attachment drops resolved, giant images stop cascading failures

body.zh-TW: 在對話中上傳圖片與文件附件時，檔案傳輸與處理邏輯迎來全方位修復。在長對話中，若先前曾有一張超大尺寸圖片被 API 拒絕，過去會導致後續每一輪對話新附帶的圖片全部跟著丟失，現在這項連鎖錯誤已經排除。當 Claude 正在運算產出時若你在輸入框追加發送訊息，內含的文件區塊不再被漏掉。在 VS Code 或桌面版中背景附加的圖片，系統不再強制以原始超大尺寸硬塞給伺服器，降低長對話反覆報錯的機會。針對接近正方形的大型圖片，新模型上的座標提示偏移問題已重新校準。遠端工作階段中途下載卡住的附件，現在也會自動重新嘗試下載。此外，貼上圖片時模組改寫提示詞被吞掉的毛病也已修復。
body.en: When attaching pictures and document payloads across conversations, file transmission and pipeline processing have received comprehensive fixes. In extended threads, if an oversized image was previously rejected by the API, that single rejection used to drop newly attached images in every subsequent turn; this cascading error has now been eliminated. If you queue an additional message while Claude is actively generating responses, attached document blocks are no longer silently omitted. For images attached in the background within VS Code or desktop environments, the client stops forcing massive raw dimensions onto the server, curbing recurring failures in long sessions. Large, near-square images now benefit from recalibrated coordinate hints on new models. Stalled attachment downloads in remote sessions now retry automatically. Additionally, an issue where pasted images swallowed rewritten prompt text has been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a mod's `prompt.submit` rewrite being silently dropped, sending the prompt as typed, for some prompts with a pasted image or an image that can't be read
Fixed document blocks being dropped from your own message sent while Claude is working
Fixed long conversations losing newly attached images on every turn after one oversized image was refused by the API
Fixed images attached while Claude is working (VS Code, desktop app, SDK) being sent at full size, which led to repeated image errors in long conversations
Fixed the image coordinate hint being missing or slightly off for large near-square images on newer models
Fixed a file attached to a message in a remote session being left out when its download stalled part way; the download is now tried again

title.zh-TW: 產出物監視上限提高，檔案編碼寫入不再亂碼
title.en: Artifact watch limit raised, file write encoding bugs and mojibake fixed

body.zh-TW: 管理即時產出物（Artifact）與讀寫檔案時，容量與編碼轉換的安全規範更為健全。本機工作階段現在能同時監視多達 25 個已發布的產出物，高於舊版的 10 個上限。當發布請求遭到伺服器或代理端以 HTTP 403 拒絕時，系統不再盲目建議重試，而是具體回報權限受限並指導使用者。在檔案讀寫方面，Read 工具先前讀取帶有位元組順序記號的 UTF-16LE 檔案會產生亂碼，Write 工具也曾發生丟失記號或擅自將其他編碼轉為 UTF-8 的危險行為，現在遇到這類特殊編碼會明確拒絕防止資料損壞。此外，差異比對介面處理頭尾帶有空格的檔名時不再搞錯名稱，大頁面因單一換行引發的發布衝突也已解決。
body.en: When managing live Artifacts and reading or writing workspace files, capacity limits and encoding protections are much sturdier. Local sessions can now watch up to 25 published artifacts simultaneously, up from the previous ceiling of 10. When publishing requests receive an HTTP 403 refusal from servers or proxy endpoints, the system stops blindly recommending a retry, returning specific permission diagnostics alongside actionable guidance instead. On the file I/O front, the Read tool previously produced mojibake when opening UTF-16LE files containing byte-order marks, while the Write tool occasionally stripped marks or converted alien encodings to UTF-8 without consent; the Read tool now reads such files correctly, and the Write tool now explicitly refuses to save in these special encodings to prevent data corruption. Furthermore, diff viewers no longer mangle filenames with leading or trailing whitespace, and publishing conflicts caused by solitary newlines on large pages are resolved.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool advising a retry when a publish that requests connectors or other access was refused by the server or a proxy (HTTP 403); it now says so and what to tell the user
Fixed the diff view listing a new file whose name begins or ends with a space under the wrong name
Fixed the Artifact tool reporting a spurious one-line difference against the live page, and refusing the publish, when a large page with a line break after `<head>` is published again unchanged
Fixed replies cut off at the output token limit ending the turn silently, with no retry or error, after a request fell back to non-streaming mode
Fixed Read garbling UTF-16LE files with a byte-order mark, and Write dropping byte-order marks or silently converting Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK or UTF-16BE files to UTF-8 (now refused)
Improved artifact watching: a local session can now watch up to 25 published artifacts at once, up from 10

title.zh-TW: 背景隊友狀態透明化，密鑰外洩與重複回報修復
title.en: Background teammate statuses clarified, secret leaks and duplicate runs fixed

body.zh-TW: 讓背景代理人（Agent）與隊友協同作業時，通知反饋與資訊安全更加可靠。背景代理的通知訊息現在會精準說明細部狀態，包括它只是在等待自身的背景工作、收到的訊息晚於產出結果，或是因為額度上限而被強制停止。如果啟動隊友時未指定描述，系統不再把提示詞中的機密登入資訊誤當成任務描述顯示在面板上，杜絕憑證外洩風險。在自動模式下，背景子代理不再把最終報告重複發送兩次。重新啟動終端機並恢復工作階段後，`SendMessage` 也能依照名稱找到子代理（最近一次壓縮之前取的名稱仍需改用 agent ID）。此外，當已結束的子代理或被終止的隊友重新喚醒時，模組掛鉤現在會如實收到恢復通知並具備否決權限。
body.en: When collaborating with background agents and teammates, notification clarity and credential safeguards are significantly tighter. Status updates from background agents now articulate precise operational states, specifying whether an agent is simply waiting on internal subtasks, whether incoming messages trailed behind generated outputs, or whether it halted due to quota ceilings. If a teammate launches without an explicit description, the runtime no longer mistakes sensitive credentials in the prompt for task summaries on your dashboard, eliminating inadvertent credential leaks. In auto mode, background subagents stop delivering final summaries twice. After relaunching the terminal and resuming sessions, `SendMessage` locates subagents by their assigned names (though names established prior to the most recent context compaction still require an agent ID). Additionally, when dormant subagents or killed teammates get revived, system hooks now receive resumption events alongside full veto power.

items.original:
Fixed an agent teammate started without a description keeping part of a credential from its prompt in the task description shown for it
Fixed the `agent.spawn` mod hook not running when a finished subagent or a killed teammate is resumed: the hook's event now carries `resume`, and a mod can refuse it
Fixed background subagents in auto mode sometimes sending their final report twice, once as the result and once as a message
Fixed `SendMessage` not finding a subagent by name after the CLI restarted and resumed the session (names given before the last compaction still need the agent ID)
Improved background agent notifications: they now say when an agent is only waiting on its own background work, got a message too late for its result, or was stopped by a usage limit

title.zh-TW: 排程喚醒時間精準校對，日光節約交替不再搶跑
title.en: Scheduled wake-up precision tuned, daylight saving transitions stop misfiring

body.zh-TW: 為 Claude 設定定時排程與自動喚醒時，時間計算的準確度獲得全盤校準。排程工具過去在播報任務預計執行時間時常會偏差一分鐘，現在已修正為如實回報下一次運行的真實時刻。在日光節約時間（夏令時間）結束並重複同一小時的時區交替期間，排程任務與迴圈先前會在每一回合反覆被觸發甚至提前偷跑，這個時間計算漏洞已經徹底修復。在 Agent SDK、IDE 與遠端遙控環境下，當背景有其他任務正在執行時，定時喚醒機制先前會遭到壓制而無法發動，現在皆能準時觸發。此外，當設定檔啟用進階功能時，無頭模式的排程回合也能正確收到環境通報。以前排程容易搶跑或延遲，現在分毫不差。
body.en: When configuring timers and automated wake-up triggers for Claude, scheduling calculations are fully realigned. The scheduling tool previously displayed expected execution times off by an entire minute, but it now faithfully reports the precise minute of the next run. When daylight saving time ends and the same hour repeats, recurring jobs and loops previously triggered repeatedly or jumped ahead early; this temporal calculation flaw has been completely patched. In the Agent SDK, IDE extensions, and remote control sessions where active background tasks used to suppress scheduled timers, prompt wake-ups now fire punctually regardless of background load. Furthermore, headless scheduled turns now correctly receive the environment notice whenever advanced features are enabled in settings. Automations used to fire prematurely or fall behind, but intervals now hit their mark reliably.

items.original:
Fixed scheduled wakeups (ScheduleWakeup) not firing while a background task was running in Agent SDK, IDE and `claude remote-control` sessions
Fixed scheduled tasks being announced for the wrong minute: the scheduling tools now report each job's actual next run time
Fixed scheduled tasks and loops firing again after every turn, or firing early, during the repeated hour when daylight saving time ends
Fixed Ultracode not being announced to scheduled tasks and other delivered headless turns when `ultracode` is on in settings

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行程序相容修復，遺留程序與環境變數排除
title.en: Windows process management repaired, orphaned runners and PATH bugs fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 平台上運行 Claude Code 時，底層命令執行與資源回收修復多項盲點。在忙碌的主機上檢查處理程序是否存活時，過去容易在系統中殘留無人認領的孤兒 PowerShell 行程，累積到最後甚至耗盡記憶體，現在程序生命週期已經能正常結束。如果電腦尚未安裝 Git for Windows，未特別指定命令解譯器的工具使用前檢查與權限授權掛鉤，過去會因找不到執行環境而門戶大開直接放行，現在遇到防護檢查失敗時會直接阻擋工具呼叫以策安全。此外，修復了 Git Bash 在啟動時若未正確回報環境路徑（PATH），導致整場工作階段中所有 Bash 指令全部回報找不到指令而癱瘓的嚴重問題。
body.en: Running Claude Code on Windows brings major fixes to low-level process dispatching and system cleanup routines. When polling whether background tasks remain alive on busy hosts, orphaned PowerShell runners previously piled up unnoticed in memory tables, occasionally exhausting available RAM; process lifecycles now terminate cleanly. On machines lacking Git for Windows, pre-tool evaluation checks and authorization hooks that lacked an explicit shell runner previously opened system gates by letting commands execute unchecked whenever environments were missing; failed guard validations now outright block execution for security. Furthermore, an issue where Git Bash failed to report system PATH variables on startup—leaving every subsequent Bash command broken with command-not-found errors throughout the entire session—has been eliminated.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed the process-liveness check leaving orphaned PowerShell processes behind on busy machines until memory ran out
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks that set no shell failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed; a guard that fails now blocks the call
Windows: Fixed Bash commands failing with "command not found" for a whole session when Git Bash did not report its PATH at startup

title.zh-TW: 計畫模式權限提醒上線，刪除指令過濾不再誤判
title.en: Plan mode permission reminder added, delete filter false alarms cleared

body.zh-TW: 使用計畫模式（plan mode）規劃複雜任務時，系統安全防護更加嚴密。當環境中開啟了跳過授權功能時，進入計畫模式現在會顯示一次性提示，告知你大部分的檔案修改與指令執行將不會逐一向你詢問確認。計畫模式現在會嚴格禁止任何寫入操作，即便該操作被前置檢查掛鉤所放行也一律強制擋下。在終端機執行腳本時，過濾刪除指令的機制不再神經質，針對未真正執行 `rm` 的腳本不再彈出不必要的刪除警告。當切換至不支援自動模式的模型時，無頭模式工作階段不會再硬留在自動模式中。雲端工作階段重啟時重複執行核准工具的瑕疵，以及瀏覽器擴充功能未連線時的提示也已一併修正。
body.en: Planning complex tasks with plan mode now features reinforced environmental controls. When bypass-authorization flags are active in your settings, entering plan mode presents a one-time reminder explaining that file edits and terminal executions will not prompt for routine confirmation. Plan mode strictly prohibits all write operations across the workspace, rejecting write requests immediately even when approved by preceding hook interceptors. During terminal command execution, deletion filters no longer trigger false alarms on harmless scripts that do not actually invoke `rm`. When switching to models that do not support auto mode, headless sessions no longer get locked into that mode against their capabilities. Duplicate tool execution hiccups occurring during cloud session reboots and missing warnings for disconnected browser companions have also been corrected.

items.original:
Added a one-time note when plan mode won't ask before most edits or commands because bypass permissions is available
Fixed rm prompts on shell `-c` scripts that don't run `rm`. An rm built at run time in a script Claude Code can't read no longer prompts unless `CLAUDE_CODE_STRICT_INLINE_SHELL_RM_PROMPT=1`
Fixed SDK and headless sessions staying in auto mode after the host switched to a model that doesn't support auto mode
Fixed Claude in Chrome asking for permission while no browser is connected; it now says the extension is not connected
Fixed a regression in 2.1.296 where cloud and headless sessions could run an approved tool call twice if a new message arrived as the session resumed after a restart
Fixed plan mode running a write (an MCP tool's, a file's, a shell command's) that a `PreToolUse` hook or a mod's `tool.check` hook allowed

title.zh-TW: 設定檔錯誤主動回報，網頁爬取深度智慧匹配
title.en: Config validation errors surfaced, web fetching adapts to thinking depth

body.zh-TW: 在文字輸出模式下運行時，系統的錯誤反饋與爬取機制迎來貼心調整。執行 `claude -p` 時若設定檔驗證失敗，終端機不再毫無反應地默默退出，而是會在標準錯誤輸出中列出出錯的檔案路徑與無效設定項目。當你在 `/config` 切換推播通知開關時，伺服器不再把上一動的舊設定誤存進帳號中。若啟動時帶入了無法辨識的模型識別碼，歡迎橫幅下方現在會收攏成簡潔的一行警示並附上說明文件連結。針對 WebFetch 讀取網頁的行為，系統現在會比照網路搜尋的邏輯，智慧配合呼叫者當前模型的思考深度。另外，安全防護通知中已移除申請驗證計畫的舊指示。以前排查設定錯誤宛如瞎子摸象，現在問題根源一目了然。
body.en: Operating in plain print mode now provides cleaner feedback and smarter scraping mechanisms. When running `claude -p` encounters configuration validation failures, the terminal stops silently exiting without a trace, writing the problematic configuration paths and invalid keys straight to standard error instead. Toggling the push notification switches inside `/config` no longer causes the server to persist outdated settings from prior states. Supplying an unrecognized model identifier at startup cleanly condenses welcome banners into a single diagnostic warning paired with documentation links. WebFetch operations retrieving page content now mirror live web search behavior, intelligently adapting scrapers to match the thinking budget of the calling model. In addition, deprecated application instructions for verification programs have been removed from security banners. Resolving setup errors once felt like guesswork, but root causes are now immediately apparent.

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` saying nothing when a settings file fails validation: text-output runs now list the file and the invalid entry on stderr
Fixed `/config` push notification toggles sending your account the previous setting instead of the one you just chose
Improved the startup warning for an unrecognized model ID: it is now one short line under the welcome banner with a docs link, instead of a long raw message
Changed WebFetch page reads to pick their effort as web searches do: the caller's level on the caller's own model, otherwise the level settings give the small model
Changed the cyber safeguard notice to no longer ask people to apply to the Cyber Verification Program

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 視窗啟動加速，未送出草稿不再遺失
title.en: [VSCode] Window launch accelerated, unsubmitted prompt drafts preserved

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡使用 Claude Code 擴充套件時，工作階段切換與啟動速度獲得了明顯優化。你在對話框輸入到一半尚未送出的提示詞與檔案附件，在切換到其他對話視窗再切回來時會完整保留，不再憑空消失。在尚未配置 Python 環境的工作區中，Claude 會在 Python 套件載入的同時同步啟動，有效縮短等待時間；針對曾開啟過的專案資料夾，新視窗中的模型選擇器與斜線指令選單現在一開就能立刻就緒。在資源管理上，開啟新對話後未使用的空白聊天視窗不再霸佔背景處理程序。此外，當你在未登入狀態點擊語音麥克風按鈕時，介面不再跳出冷冰冰的內部錯誤代碼，而是貼心引導你完成登入。
body.en: Using the Claude Code extension within VS Code brings noticeable speedups to launch sequences and session transitions. Prompts and file attachments typed halfway into the composer without being sent are preserved intact when hopping across conversation splits, no longer vanishing into thin air. In project folders lacking a prepared Python runtime, Claude starts up in parallel while Python libraries load behind the scenes, substantially cutting down launch delays; for previously indexed workspace folders, the model selector and slash command menus appear instantly in new panels. Regarding resource management, blank chat windows abandoned after starting fresh tasks release background runners rather than consuming memory. Furthermore, clicking the audio microphone icon while signed out guides you directly through login instead of flashing internal error codes.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed an unsent prompt and its attachments being lost when switching to another session and back
[VSCode] Fixed unused blank chats keeping a background Claude process running after starting a new conversation
[VSCode] Fixed the mic button showing an internal error message when you are signed out of claude.ai; it now offers to sign you in
[VSCode] Improved startup time in workspaces without a Python environment by starting Claude while the Python extension loads
[VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker and slash command menu now fill in right away in a new window on a folder you've opened before

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 雲端環境部署命令完整顯示，刪除環境即刻停用常規任務
title.en: [Cloud sessions] Cloud deployment commands expand fully, deleting an environment immediately disables routines

body.zh-TW: 管理雲端自架環境與例行常規任務（routine）時，操作反饋與防護流程顯著升級。在建立自架環境或金鑰時，畫面上顯示的部署指令現在會完整展開、在參數間適當換行，並附上顯眼的複製按鈕。當管理者刪除某個自架環境時，綁定該環境的常規任務會立刻被自動停用並標註原因，不再放任排程在背景無端報錯。在編輯常規任務時，即便所屬環境已被刪除，也不會再偷偷被移轉到其他無關的環境中。在管理介面中貼上工作階段 ID 搜尋時，先前查無結果的問題已修復；當搜尋沒有相符項目時，介面會清楚提示無符合項目而非誤報清單為空。此外，大量既有產出檔案同時回傳導致工作階段記憶體瞬間暴增崩潰的漏洞也已排除。
body.en: When managing cloud self-hosted environments and routines, operational feedback and safeguards receive a major upgrade. When creating a self-hosted environment or key, deployment commands shown on screen now expand fully, break appropriately across parameters, and include a prominent copy button. When an administrator deletes a self-hosted environment, routines bound to that environment are immediately disabled automatically with the reason noted, preventing schedules from throwing errors aimlessly in the background. When editing a routine, it will no longer be silently transferred to another unrelated environment even if its associated environment has been deleted. In the management console, searching by pasting a session ID previously returned no results, which has now been fixed. When a search yields no matches, the interface clearly indicates that no matching items were found instead of erroneously reporting an empty list. Additionally, a vulnerability where returning large volumes of existing generated files simultaneously caused session memory to surge and crash has also been resolved.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed a memory spike that could crash a session when many of its existing output files were re-sent to it at once
[Cloud sessions] Fixed saving an edited routine silently moving it to a different environment when its own had been deleted or wasn't in the list; the routine now keeps its environment
[Cloud sessions] Fixed Sessions search in a self-hosted environment's admin details finding nothing when you paste the session ID from a session's link
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Sessions and Runners lists in a self-hosted environment's admin details saying the list is empty when a search just has no matches
[Cloud sessions] Improved the deploy command shown when you create a self-hosted environment or environment key: it shows in full, wraps between arguments, and has a visible copy button
[Cloud sessions] Changed deleting a self-hosted environment to turn off its routines right away, with the reason shown on each routine, instead of leaving their runs to fail

title.zh-TW: [Remote Control] 離線時保留輸入內容，防止送出未抵達訊息
title.en: [Remote Control] Retain input content while offline, preventing undelivered message sends

body.zh-TW: 當你的遠端電腦暫時斷線或無法連線時，遠端遙控視窗不再假裝訊息已經順利送出。以前在連線中斷時按下送出，文字會直接從輸入框消失，讓人誤以為指令已經送達遠端主機執行，直到苦等許久才發現電腦根本沒收到。現在只要偵測到連線中斷，你輸入的內容會安穩留在輸入框裡，送出按鈕也會維持反灰鎖定狀態，直到重新連上電腦為止。⟦就像在櫃檯按服務鈴，以前線路斷線時按鈕照樣沉下去，讓人以為服務生聽到了；現在只要訊號中斷按鈕就會卡住鎖死，手上的留言條也會好好留在你面前，等你確定對方在場再遞出。⟧
body.en: When your remote computer is temporarily disconnected or unreachable, the remote control window no longer pretends that messages were successfully sent. Previously, pressing send during a connection drop made the text vanish directly from the input box, giving the false impression that commands had reached the remote host for execution, only for you to wait endlessly before discovering the computer never received them. Now, as long as a connection drop is detected, your entered content remains safely in the input box, and the send button stays grayed out and locked until you reconnect to the computer. ⟦A customer presses a service bell at a counter. In the past, the button still pressed down when the wire was cut, leading people to believe the attendant heard it. Now, whenever the signal drops, the button locks firmly in place, and your note stays safely in front of you until you confirm someone is present before handing it over.⟧

items.original: [Remote Control] Fixed Remote Control sessions whose computer can't be reached still appearing to send your messages; your text now stays in the box and Send is off until it reconnects

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 訊息原地編輯修正，百人群組安靜加入
title.en: [Claude Tag] In-place Slack message edits for corrections, quiet joins in large groups of 100 members

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道中使用 Claude 機器人時，互動禮節與編輯習慣變得更加優雅。當 Claude 需要更正先前回答錯誤的訊息時，現在會直接在原地編輯該則留言並附上簡短的「已編輯」標註，不再把整段舊文字劃上刪除線弄亂版面。當它被邀請加入超過 100 名成員的大型群組時，現在會保持安靜默默加入，不再大肆張貼自我介紹洗版。如果頻道成員要求刪除它先前建立的畫布（canvas），Claude 現在也能順從指令直接刪除。在有訪客的頻道中，若頻道指示要求它回答未標註自己的貼文，Claude 不再沉默神隱。此外，回覆未加入的私密討論串會明確回報無法送達，自架執行器缺少 Python 環境導致發不出訊息的狀況也已修正。
body.en: When using the Claude bot in Slack channels, interaction etiquette and editing behavior become much more refined. When Claude needs to correct a previously inaccurate answer, it now edits the message directly in place with a concise "edited" label, rather than cluttering the channel by striking through entire blocks of old text. When invited to large groups with more than 100 members, it now joins quietly in silence instead of spamming the channel with a broad self-introduction announcement. If channel members ask to delete a canvas it previously created, Claude now follows the instruction and deletes it directly. In channels with guest users, Claude no longer stays silent when channel instructions require it to reply to posts that do not tag it. Additionally, replying to unjoined private threads now explicitly reports that the message could not be delivered, and an issue where self-hosted runners failed to send messages due to a missing Python environment has also been resolved.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added the ability for Claude in Slack to delete a canvas it created in a channel when someone asks it to
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack staying silent on untagged posts that a channel's own instructions tell it to answer, such as posts that tag someone else, in channels with guests
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack reporting a reply to another channel's thread as posted when it isn't a member there; it now says the reply wasn't delivered and how to fix that
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes ending a turn without posting its answer when a self-hosted runner's image has no python3
[Claude Tag] Changed how Claude in Slack corrects a message it got wrong: it edits the message in place and adds a short "Edited" note instead of striking through the old text
[Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to join channels with more than 100 members quietly, with no intro message

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 每月支出上限超標引導，直達專屬用量設定頁
title.en: [Code Review] Exceeded monthly spend limit guidance, direct navigation to dedicated Usage settings

body.zh-TW: 你在專案的合併請求中收到審查留言，或是發現檢查清單提示本月費用已經達到上限時，能更快找到調整額度的地方。通知卡片與留言先前會誤把管理員帶到一般的 Claude Code 設定選單，讓人到處翻找卻找不到修改位置。現在點擊通知裡的連結，會直接導向用量（Usage）專屬頁面，也就是設定該上限的正確位置。⟦就像收到水電帳單逾期通知，以前單子上的繳費網址只連到自來水公司首頁，讓人點進去像無頭蒼蠅般到處亂找；現在通知附上的連結會直接開啟繳費扣款頁面，點開就能立即處理。⟧
body.en: When you receive review comments in a project's pull request or notice a checklist warning that this month's spending has hit the limit, you can find the place to adjust quotas much faster. Notification cards and comments previously led administrators to the general Claude Code settings menu by mistake, leaving them searching everywhere without finding where to make changes. Now, clicking the link in the notification directs you straight to the dedicated Usage page, which is the exact place to configure that limit. ⟦An overdue utility bill arrives with a warning. In the past, the payment link on the slip led only to the water company's homepage, leaving you clicking through and searching around aimlessly. Now, the link attached to the notification directly opens the payment processing page, letting you take care of it immediately.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review's monthly spend-limit comment and check-run card sending admins to Claude Code settings; they now link the Usage page, where that limit is set

entries: Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name
Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room
Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn
Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions
Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins
Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings

Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read
Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere
Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted
Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag
Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string
Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal
Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open
Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through
Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order
Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1
Fixed workflow scripts silently truncating results, agent options and other values nested deeper than about 20,000 levels, and deeply nested results writing huge task output files
Fixed a plugin's served `$` methods running in the main session's working directory instead of the calling agent's, and ignoring the turn their calling hook holds
Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused
Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal error for a marketplace named like `constructor`; `add` now refuses such names clearly
Fixed a plugin secret named `constructor` or `prototype` being deleted by the next save of that plugin's options
Fixed cloud sessions skipping auto mode's checks on Claude in Chrome actions that a saved permission allows when their feature flags had not loaded
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a finished turn after a restart when an MCP tool result had ended that turn
Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some commands that assign the `BASH_ARGV0` shell variable and then use it; these now prompt for approval
Fixed Edit and NotebookEdit replacing every non-ASCII character in files that are not valid UTF-8 (Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK); such edits are now refused
Fixed a prompt sent just after `←` being run twice, once unseen in the foreground, when the background service was slow to answer
Fixed a prompt sent while SessionStart hooks were still running vanishing when `←` moved the session to the background; it is still not sent, but `↑` now brings it back
Fixed a late-loading plugin's SessionStart hook output reaching the new conversation after `/clear` in headless sessions
Fixed PowerShell commands not seeing variables that hooks write to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE (when the file holds only plain assignments)
Fixed Claude calling cloud sessions non-interactive and suggesting `/mcp` or `claude mcp` when an MCP server needs authentication
Fixed `/code-review` ending on a raw JSON array in cloud sessions, the Agent SDK and IDE integrations; the findings now print as a numbered list
Fixed auto mode occasionally refusing one update to your own artifact, saying its sharing had changed when it had not
Fixed skills synced from claude.ai never finishing their install, and being downloaded again at every sync, when several sessions share a config directory
Fixed a plugin synced from claude.ai being disabled when the marketplace dependency it declares was also synced from claude.ai
Fixed a startup hang on macOS when plugin paths copied from a Linux machine pointed under /home
Fixed the Workflow tool refusing script files with CRLF line endings, such as files checked out on Windows
Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` or `git -C <dir> commit`
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping a message from the saved transcript when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Fixed `claude purge` leaving a prompt in the history file when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands longer than about 1 KB always asking for permission, so allow rules and read-only detection now apply up to 32 KB
Windows: Fixed stdio MCP servers being force-killed at shutdown; stdin now closes first and the process tree is killed only if the server is still running after 300 ms
Windows: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub `owner/repo` plugin sources on machines with no GitHub SSH key; the clone is now retried over HTTPS
Windows: Fixed `rm -rf /c/Users/<name>` in Git Bash not asking in bypass permissions mode
Improved fullscreen mode: the link under the mouse pointer is now underlined to show it can be opened
Improved transcript toggle (ctrl+o) responsiveness in code-heavy conversations by caching syntax-highlighted code blocks
Improved Claude Desktop's Code tab behind a Claude apps gateway: when a session can't start, including on a machine not set up for the gateway's `code` settings, the reason shows as a reply
Improved the errors for a refused cloud session: they now say why your organization's policy couldn't be loaded, and name an API key or auth token that overrides your claude.ai login
Improved `--debug` output to name unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a hint for likely typos
Improved auto mode: a tool call that wasn't run because auto mode's check had no usable answer now shows as a dim "Not run" row instead of a red error
Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable
Improved `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`: a large transcript file is no longer rewritten when that would free under 10% of it
Updated `/cost`, the status line, `--max-budget-usd` and the SDK's cost figures to price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per million tokens (was $0.20)
Updated the bundled dataviz skill: lighter violet for the seventh series in light mode, softer primary text in dark mode, and compact y-axis labels like 1K
Changed the default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions from 2,048 to 4,096 characters

[VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` missing from the extension's settings, so settings.json now completes and validates it; a malformed value no longer breaks the chat panel

[VSCode] Fixed chat links written as a full Windows path, such as C:\repo\file.ts or file:///C:/repo/file.ts, not opening the file on Windows
[VSCode] Fixed the working indicator still animating when reduced motion is turned on in your OS, in VS Code, or with the `prefersReducedMotion` setting
